    (exists i, U = Typeω@i) \/ (exists L n, U = Type⟨L⟩ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n).
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto 6. Qed.

The sort of a typed record is a universe.
Lemma record_typed_sort_univ : forall Θ Ξ R, record_typed Θ Ξ R -> ind_sort_univ (record_sort R).
Proof.
  intros * Ht; destruct (is_univ_cases _ _ _ _ (typed_sort _ _ _ Ht)) as [(i & ->) | (L & n & -> & _)];
    [ left | right ]; eauto.
Qed.

The context of a typed record's first k fields over its parameters is well formed: each field is a type of the sort, a universe.
Lemma record_typed_fctx_wf : forall Θ Ξ R, record_typed Θ Ξ R ->
    forall k, k <= List.length (record_fields R) -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_fctx R k ++ record_params R.
Proof.
  intros * [Ha Hmv Hs Hnd Hf Hrl Hfk]; pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx Hs) as HP.
  induction k as [| k IH]; intros Hk; [ exact HP |].
  assert (Hlt : k < List.length (record_fields R)) by lia.
  destruct (List.nth_error (record_fields R) k) as [[f T] |] eqn:HT;
    [| apply List.nth_error_None in HT; lia ].
  rewrite (record_fctx_succ _ _ _ _ HT); cbn [List.app].
  specialize (IH ltac:(lia)).
  pose proof (Hf _ _ _ HT) as HTt.
  destruct (Hfk k); cbn [abs_kind_sort] in HTt;
    [| eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ exact HTt | constructor ] ].
  pose proof (wf_wk_shiftn_app _ _ _ _ IH HP) as Hw; rewrite length_record_fctx in Hw by lia.
  destruct (is_univ_cases _ _ _ _ Hs) as [(i & HU) | (L & n & HU & HL)]; rewrite HU in HTt; cbn in HTt.
  - eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ exact HTt | constructor ].
  - pose proof (wk_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HL Hw) as HL'; cbn in HL'.
    eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ exact (@wf_exp_suniv_large _ _ _ _ _ 0 _ HL' HTt) | constructor ].
Qed.

The type of a typed record's type former is a type.
Lemma record_typed_ty : forall Θ Ξ R, record_typed Θ Ξ R -> exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ record_ty R : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * [Ha Hmv Hs Hnd Hf Hrl Hfk]; pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx Hs) as HP.
  destruct (wf_is_univ_typ Hs) as [i Hi].
  unfold record_ty; apply (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ nil _ i); rewrite List.app_nil_r; assumption.
Qed.

The type former of a typed record found at p is typed.
Lemma record_typed_former : forall Θ Ξ Γ p R, record_typed Θ Ξ R -> record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_record p : record_ty R.
Proof.
  intros * HR Hl HΓ; pose proof HR as [Ha Hmv Hs Hnd Hf Hrl Hfk].
  destruct (record_typed_ty _ _ _ HR) as [i Hi].
  eapply wf_record; [ exact HΓ | exact Hl | exact Hnd | exact Ha | exact Hi
                    | exact (record_typed_fctx_wf _ _ _ HR _ (le_n _)) | exact Hs | exact Hf | exact Hrl | exact Hfk ].
Qed.

A record entry, and the module of a record type, have a typed declaration: it is checked where the module starts (wf_gmod_record_nil).
Lemma wf_record_typed_all :
  (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> forall pv pr R Φ, E = ge_record pv pr R Φ -> record_typed Θ Ξ R) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> forall R, K = fk_record R -> record_typed Θ Ξ R).
Proof.
  apply global_wf_mut_ind; intros; try discriminate.
  - (* the declaration *)
    match goal with Heq : ge_record _ _ _ _ = ge_record _ _ _ _ |- _ => injection Heq as <- <- <- <- end.
    constructor; assumption.
  - (* with the body of its module *)
    match goal with Heq : ge_record _ _ _ _ = ge_record _ _ _ _ |- _ => injection Heq as <- <- <- <- end.
    match goal with IH : forall R, fk_record _ = fk_record R -> _ |- _ => exact (IH _ eq_refl) end.
  - (* the module, before its members *)
    match goal with Heq : fk_record _ = fk_record _ |- _ => injection Heq as <- end.
    match goal with IH : forall pv pr R Φ, ge_record _ _ _ _ = _ -> _ |- _ => exact (IH _ _ _ _ eq_refl) end.
  - (* one more member of the module *)
    match goal with IH : forall R, ?K = fk_record R -> _, Heq : ?K = fk_record _ |- _ => exact (IH _ Heq) end.
Qed.

Lemma wf_gmod_record_typed : forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ ->
    forall R, K = fk_record R -> record_typed Θ Ξ R.
Proof. exact (proj2 wf_record_typed_all). Qed.

The type of a value of a typed record found at p is a type over the record's parameters: its module's telescope is well formed where the record is found. The parameters as variables are of the parameters' types, and the sort is the sort at them, as the declaration has no free module variable.
Lemma record_mod_tele_wf : forall Θ Ξ p R, record_typed Θ Ξ R -> record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_mod_tele p R.
Proof.
  intros * HR Hl; pose proof HR as [Ha Hmv Hs Hnd Hf Hrl Hfk]; pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx Hs) as HP.
  destruct (wf_is_univ_typ Hs) as [i Hi].
  pose proof (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HP) as HsP.
  destruct (proj1 (proj2 wf_scoped) _ _ _ _ _ Hi) as (_ & HsS & _).
  assert (Hself : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_params R ⊢ record_self p R : record_sort R).
  { pose proof (wf_apps_closed_pi _ _ (record_params R) (record_sort R) i (record_params R) (a_record p)
                  (vars_from 0 (List.length (record_params R))) Ha HsP HsS Hi HP
                  (record_typed_former _ _ _ _ _ HR Hl HP) (length_vars_from _ _)
                  (wf_vars_tele _ _ nil _ Ha HsP (params_mvc _ Hmv) HP)) as H.
    rewrite (exp_at_vars _ _ 0 HsS (sort_mvc _ Hmv)), exp_wk_id_ext in H by (intros x; cbn; lia).
    exact H. }
  unfold record_mod_tele.
  destruct (is_univ_cases _ _ _ _ Hs) as [(j & HU) | (L & n & HU & HL)]; rewrite HU in Hself |- *; cbn [sort_exp_kind].
  - eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ exact Hself | constructor ].
  - eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ exact (@wf_exp_suniv_large _ _ _ _ _ 0 _ HL Hself) | constructor ].
Qed.

The telescope of the frames' parameters is a well-formed context: the innermost frame's module was checked over it, one frame out, and pushing the frame is an embedding; a record's module ends with a value of the record, typed in the record's own frame, where the record is found.
Lemma wf_gs_tele : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ.
Proof.
  intros Θ [| [[mp K] U] Ξ] Hg; [ constructor; exact Hg |].
  destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as [Hs0 HU Hff Hpath].
  pose proof (wf_gunit_mod _ _ _ _ _ HU) as HΦ.
  assert (HP : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ frame_params K (gu_params U) ++ gs_tele Ξ) by exact (wf_gmod_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ).
  assert (He : gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ ((mp, K, U) :: Ξ)) by (constructor; [ exact Hg | apply gc_sub_push; exact Hff ]).
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (Hc & _).
  destruct K as [| pq k D | R]; cbn [frame_params gs_tele] in HP |- *; [ exact (Hc _ HP) | exact (Hc _ HP) |].
  destruct (wf_gmod_record_params _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ _ eq_refl) as (Δr & HΔ & HPR & _).
  rewrite HΔ; cbn [List.app]; rewrite <- HPR.
  apply (record_mod_tele_wf _ _ mp R).
  - exact (gctx_embedding_preserves_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ He (wf_gmod_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ _ eq_refl)).
  - unfold record_lookup; rewrite gs_find_record_own; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma wf_gmod_params_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ ->
    exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) (frame_params K Δ) l.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn [frame_params List.tl];
    first [ eexists; eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption | eexists; eassumption | assumption ].
Qed.

Relevant parameters stay so along an embedding.
Lemma params_evaluated_embed : forall Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 Γ Δ l,
    gctx_embedding Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 -> params_evaluated Θ1 Ξ1 Γ Δ l -> params_evaluated Θ2 Ξ2 Γ Δ l.
Proof.
  intros * He HR Δ1 κ T Δ2 E; destruct (HR _ _ _ _ E) as [H | H]; [ left | right ];
    exact (proj1 (proj2 (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He)) _ _ _ H).
Qed.

The type of a record's value, over its parameters, is a type of a large universe.
Lemma record_self_large : forall Θ Ξ p R, record_typed Θ Ξ R -> record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R ->
    exists j, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_params R ⊢ record_self p R : Typeω@j.
Proof.
  intros * HR Hl; pose proof HR as [Ha Hmv Hs Hnd Hf Hrl Hfk]; pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx Hs) as HP.
  destruct (wf_is_univ_typ Hs) as [i Hi].
  pose proof (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HP) as HsP.
  destruct (proj1 (proj2 wf_scoped) _ _ _ _ _ Hi) as (_ & HsS & _).
  assert (Hself : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_params R ⊢ record_self p R : record_sort R).
  { pose proof (wf_apps_closed_pi _ _ (record_params R) (record_sort R) i (record_params R) (a_record p)
                  (vars_from 0 (List.length (record_params R))) Ha HsP HsS Hi HP
                  (record_typed_former _ _ _ _ _ HR Hl HP) (length_vars_from _ _)
                  (wf_vars_tele _ _ nil _ Ha HsP (params_mvc _ Hmv) HP)) as H.
    rewrite (exp_at_vars _ _ 0 HsS (sort_mvc _ Hmv)), exp_wk_id_ext in H by (intros x; cbn; lia).
    exact H. }
  destruct (is_univ_cases _ _ _ _ Hs) as [(j & HU) | (L & n & HU & HL)]; rewrite HU in Hself.
  - exists j; exact Hself.
  - exists 0; exact (@wf_exp_suniv_large _ _ _ _ _ 0 _ HL Hself).
Qed.

The telescope of the frames' parameters consists of types of a universe: each frame's own parameters by (R), read one frame out and moved into the stack pushed, and a record's module's value, typed in the record's own frame.
Lemma wf_gs_tele_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (gs_tele Ξ) l.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ; induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros Hg.
  - exists 0; apply params_evaluated_nil.
  - destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as [Hs0 HU Hff Hpath].
    pose proof (wf_gunit_mod _ _ _ _ _ HU) as HΦ.
    assert (He : gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ ((mp, K, U) :: Ξ)) by (constructor; [ exact Hg | apply gc_sub_push; exact Hff ]).
    destruct (IH Hs0) as [l0 H0].
    destruct (wf_gmod_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ) as [l1 H1].
    pose proof (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He H0) as H0'.
    pose proof (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He H1) as H1'.
    cbn [gs_tele].
    destruct K as [| pq k D | R]; cbn [frame_params] in H1'.
    + exists (max l1 l0); apply params_evaluated_app; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact H1' | exact H0' ].
    + exists (max l1 l0); apply params_evaluated_app; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact H1' | exact H0' ].
    + destruct (wf_gmod_record_params _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ _ eq_refl) as (Δr & HΔ & HPR & _).
      rewrite HΔ in H1' |- *; cbn [List.tl] in H1'.
      destruct (record_self_large _ _ mp R
                  (gctx_embedding_preserves_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ He (wf_gmod_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ _ eq_refl))
                  ltac:(unfold record_lookup; rewrite gs_find_record_own; reflexivity)) as [j Hj].
      exists (max j (max l1 l0)).
      change (ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self mp R) :: Δr) with ((ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self mp R) :: nil) ++ Δr).
      rewrite <- List.app_assoc.
      apply params_evaluated_app; [| apply params_evaluated_app; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact H1' | exact H0' ] ].
      intros Δ1 κ T Δ2 E; destruct Δ1 as [| e Δ1]; cbn in E; [| destruct Δ1; discriminate ].
      injection E as <- <- <-; left; rewrite List.app_nil_r, <- HPR; exact Hj.
Qed.

Relevant parameters over the frames' parameters, with these: relevant in the empty context.
Lemma params_evaluated_over_stack : forall Θ Ξ Δ l, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
    exists l', params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) l'.
Proof.
  intros * Hg HR; destruct (wf_gs_tele_evaluated _ _ Hg) as [l0 H0].
  exists (max l l0); apply params_evaluated_app; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HR | exact H0 ].
Qed.

A filed record's parameters are relevant in the empty context: its own ones by the premise of wf_gentry_record, or by (R) of the body of its module (wf_gmod_params_evaluated, one entry out: the value), over the frames' parameters (params_evaluated_over_stack).
Lemma wf_gentry_record_params_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ mp pv pr R Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_record pv pr R Φ ->
    exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (record_params R) l.
Proof.
  intros * HE; inversion HE; subst.
  - match goal with HS : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ record_params R ⊢ᵤ _ |- _ => pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_is_univ_ctx HS)) as Hg end.
    match goal with HU : record_params R = _ ++ gs_tele Ξ |- _ => rewrite HU end.
    eapply params_evaluated_over_stack; [ exact Hg | first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ] ].
  - match goal with HΦ : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_record R ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (wf_gmod_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ) as [l Hl]; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (wf_gmod_ctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ)) as Hg end.
    cbn [frame_params List.tl] in Hl.
    match goal with HU : record_params R = _ ++ gs_tele Ξ |- _ => rewrite HU end.
    exact (params_evaluated_over_stack _ _ _ _ Hg Hl).
Qed.

Section Induction.
V Θ Ξ E: the (closed) entry E is valid at Θ ⍮ Ξ; VD Θ Ξ D: so is the declaration D of an inductive type.
  Variable V : gdeps -> gstack -> gentry -> Prop.
  Variable VD : gdeps -> gstack -> ind_decl -> Prop.

A definition with a module part is valid as its term part, the transparent definition it is.
  Definition dm_def (pv : bool) (A M : exp) : gentry := ge_def true pv ak_relevant A (Some M).

globals_valid Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2: everything resolving at Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 is valid at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2.
  Record globals_valid (Θ1 : gdeps) (Ξ1 : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) : Prop := mk_globals_valid
    {
Every resolving entry
      globals_valid_entries : forall p E, gc_resolve Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some E -> V Θ2 Ξ2 E
      
Every filed group
    ; globals_valid_decls : forall p D, ind_lookup Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some D -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D
      
Every definition with a module part, as its term part
    ; globals_valid_def_mods : forall p pv A M U, gc_entry Θ1 Ξ1 p = Some (ge_def_mod pv A M U) -> V Θ2 Ξ2 (dm_def pv A M) }.

Everything resolving at Θ ⍮ Ξ is valid wherever Θ ⍮ Ξ embeds.
  Definition globals_valid_along_embeddings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
    forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> globals_valid Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2.

How a definition and an axiom are made valid: from their derivation at the insertion context, given that its globals are valid. A definition is checked in a closed telescope T: the frames' parameters, or the uniform parameters of the inductive type whose module it is a member of.
  Hypothesis Hdef : forall Θ Ξ T r A M i b pv Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
      (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters T) ->
      
The telescope is of assumptions, so that the definition's filed body has no let at a type of levels (ctx_pi_type_kind)
      all_assumptions T ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ M : A -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      V Θ2 Ξ2 (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r T A) (Some (ctx_fn T M))).
  Hypothesis Hax : forall Θ Ξ r A i b pv Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
      
No axiom is of a type of levels
      r <> ak_level ->
      
The frames' parameters are assumptions (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions)
      all_assumptions (gs_tele Ξ) ->
      globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      V Θ2 Ξ2 (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r (gs_tele Ξ) A) None).
And a declaration of an inductive type.
  Hypothesis Hind : forall Θ Ξ D Θ2 Ξ2,
      decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D.

What an entry contributes is valid wherever the context it is checked in embeds and the entry's contributions are found. What an entry checked over T contributes is valid at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2.
  Record entry_contributions_valid (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (T : ctx) (E : gentry) : Prop := mk_entry_contributions_valid
    {
Every entry inside it
      entry_contributions_valid_entries : forall (ip : list String.string) E0, ge_entries E ip = Some E0 -> V Θ2 Ξ2 E0
      
The group, if it is a group's first member
    ; entry_contributions_valid_module : forall T' pq D, ge_module T E = Some (mr_body T' (Some (pq, 0, D))) -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D
      
Every group whose first member is inside it
    ; entry_contributions_valid_submodule : forall x (ip : list String.string) T' pq D,
        ge_submodule T E x ip = Some (mr_body T' (Some (pq, 0, D))) -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D
      
Every definition with a module part it is or has inside it
    ; entry_contributions_valid_def_mods : forall (ip : list String.string) pv A M U, ge_subentry E ip = Some (ge_def_mod pv A M U) ->
        V Θ2 Ξ2 (dm_def pv A M) }.

The group an entry declares, if it is a group's first member, is valid at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2.
  Definition entry_decl (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
    forall pv pq D Φ, E = ge_ind pv pq 0 D Φ -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D.

What an entry declares is valid wherever the context it is checked in embeds, and what it contributes is valid where its contributions are found too.
  Definition entry_valid_along_embeddings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
    forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      entry_decl Θ2 Ξ2 E /\ (contributions_found Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) mp E -> entry_contributions_valid Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) E).

What a body checked over T contributes is valid at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2.
  Record body_contributions_valid (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (T : ctx) (Φ : gmod) : Prop := mk_body_contributions_valid
    {
Every entry resolving in it
      body_contributions_valid_entries : forall ip E0, gm_resolve Φ ip = Some E0 -> V Θ2 Ξ2 E0
      
Every group whose first member is in it
    ; body_contributions_valid_submodule : forall x ip T' pq D, gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some (mr_body T' (Some (pq, 0, D))) -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D
      
Every definition with a module part in it
    ; body_contributions_valid_def_mods : forall ip pv A M U, gm_entry Φ ip = Some (ge_def_mod pv A M U) -> V Θ2 Ξ2 (dm_def pv A M) }.

The group a frame's kind names, if the frame is the module of the group's first member, is valid at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2.
  Definition kind_decl (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (K : frame_kind) : Prop :=
    forall pq D, K = fk_ind pq 0 D -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D.

The group a module's kind names is valid wherever the context the module is checked in embeds, and what its body contributes is valid wherever its frame embeds too.
  Definition module_valid_along_embeddings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (K : frame_kind) (Δ : ctx) (Φ : gmod) : Prop :=
    forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      kind_decl Θ2 Ξ2 K /\ (gctx_embedding Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) Θ2 Ξ2 -> body_contributions_valid Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) Φ).

  Theorem global_induction_all :
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R -> True) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> entry_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ mp E) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> module_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> globals_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ).
  Proof.
    apply wf_mut_ind_all; intros; try assumption; try exact I.
    - (* a definition or an axiom *)
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |]; intros _.
      constructor; [| discriminate | intros ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate | intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate ].
      intros [| ? ?] E0 HE; cbn in HE; inversion HE; subst.
      (* the frames' parameters are assumptions *)
      match goal with HA : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ gs_tele _ ⊢ _ : _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx HA))) as Hta end.
      match goal with HM : forall M, ?o = Some M -> _ |- _ =>
        destruct o as [M0 |]; cbn; [ specialize (HM M0 eq_refl) | clear HM ] end.
      + eapply Hdef; eauto.
      + eapply Hax; eauto.
    - (* a nested module *)
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |]; intros Hc.
      destruct (H0 _ _ He) as [_ HM].
      destruct (HM (gctx_embedding_nested _ _ _ pv fk_module _ _ _ _ He Hc I)) as [HE HU HA].
      constructor; [ exact HE | intros ? ? Hx; discriminate | exact HU |].
      intros [| z ip] ? ? ? ? Hx; [ discriminate | exact (HA _ _ _ _ _ Hx) ].
    - (* an alias: it contributes no entry and no declaration *)
      intros ? ? _; split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |]; intros _.
      constructor; [ intros ip ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate | discriminate | intros ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate
                   | intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate ].
    - (* a group, at its first member, with no member in its module *)
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He.
      assert (HD : VD Θ2 Ξ2 D) by (eapply Hind; [ build_decl_typed | eassumption | exact He ]).
      split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; injection Heq as <- _ <- _; exact HD | intros _ ].
      constructor; [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; discriminate | | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate
                   | intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? ? Hx; [ discriminate | cbn in Hx; discriminate ] ].
      intros T pq0 D0 [= _ <- <-]; exact HD.
    - (* a later declared member of a group, with no member in its module:
         it declares no group, the group's is filed *)
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; injection Heq as _ _ Hk0 _ _; lia | intros _ ].
      constructor; [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; discriminate | | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate
                   | intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? ? Hx; [ discriminate | cbn in Hx; discriminate ] ].
      intros T pq0 D0 Hx; cbn [ge_module] in Hx; injection Hx as _ _ Hk0 _; lia.
    - (* a declared member with the body of its module, checked in the
         member's open frame *)
      match goal with IH : module_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHM end.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; destruct (IHM _ _ He) as [HK HB].
      split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; injection Heq as _ <- -> <- _; exact (HK _ _ eq_refl) | intros Hc ].
      destruct (HB (gctx_embedding_nested _ _ _ pv (fk_ind pq k D) _ _ _ _ He Hc ltac:(match goal with Hu : ind_uparams D = _ |- _ => exact Hu end))) as [HΦE HΦU HΦA].
      constructor.
      + intros ip E0 HE; exact (HΦE _ _ HE).
      + intros T pq0 D0 Hx; cbn [ge_module] in Hx; injection Hx as _ <- -> <-; exact (HK _ _ eq_refl).
      + intros z ip T pq0 D0 Hx; cbn [ge_submodule] in Hx.
        match goal with Hu : ind_uparams D = _ |- _ => rewrite Hu in Hx end; exact (HΦU _ _ _ _ _ Hx).
      + intros [| z ip] ? ? ? ? Hx; [ discriminate |]; exact (HΦA _ _ _ _ _ Hx).
    - (* a definition with a module part: valid as its term part *)
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |]; intros _.
      constructor; [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; discriminate | intros ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate
                   | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate |].
      intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? ? Hx; [| discriminate ]; cbn in Hx; injection Hx as <- <- <- <-.
      match goal with HA : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ gs_tele _ ⊢ _ : _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx HA))) as Hta end.
      unfold dm_def; eapply (Hdef _ _ _ ak_relevant); [ eassumption | discriminate | exact Hta | eassumption | | exact He ].
      match goal with H : globals_valid_along_embeddings _ _ |- _ => exact H end.
    - (* a record: it contributes no entry and no declaration *)
      intros ? ? _; split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |]; intros _; constructor;
        [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate | intros ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate
        | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate | intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate ].
    - (* a record with the body of its module, checked in the record's open
         frame: it declares no group *)
      match goal with IH : module_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHM end.
      match goal with Hu : record_params R = _ |- _ => rename Hu into HRu end.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; destruct (IHM _ _ He) as [_ HB].
      split; [ intros ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq | intros Hc ].
      destruct (HB (gctx_embedding_nested _ _ _ pv (fk_record R) _ _ _ _ He Hc (ex_intro _ _ (conj eq_refl HRu)))) as [HΦE HΦU HΦA].
      constructor.
      + intros ip E0 HE; exact (HΦE _ _ HE).
      + intros T pq0 D0 Hx; cbn [ge_module] in Hx; discriminate.
      + intros z ip T pq0 D0 Hx; cbn [ge_submodule] in Hx; unfold record_mod_tele in Hx; rewrite HRu in Hx.
        exact (HΦU _ _ _ _ _ Hx).
      + intros [| z ip] ? ? ? ? Hx; [ cbn in Hx; discriminate |]; exact (HΦA _ _ _ _ _ Hx).
    - (* the empty module *)
      intros ? ? _; split; [ intros ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq | intros _ ].
      constructor; [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; discriminate | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate |].
      intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate.
    - (* the module of a member, before its members: the member's group *)
      match goal with IH : entry_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHE end.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split.
      + intros pq0 D0 Heq; injection Heq as -> -> ->.
        exact (proj1 (IHE _ _ He) _ _ _ _ eq_refl).
      + intros _; constructor; [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; discriminate | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate |].
        intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate.
    - (* the module of a record, before its members: no group *)
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split.
      + intros pq0 D0 Heq; discriminate Heq.
      + intros _; constructor; [ intros [| ? ?] ? Hx; discriminate | intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; discriminate |].
        intros ? ? ? ? ? Hx; cbn in Hx; discriminate.
    - (* extending a module *)
      match goal with IH : module_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHΦ end.
      match goal with IH : entry_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHE end.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He0; destruct (IHΦ _ _ He0) as [HK HB]; split; [ exact HK | intros He ].
      assert (He' : gctx_embedding Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) Θ2 Ξ2)
        by (eapply gctx_embedding_pre; [ apply gc_sub_grow; eassumption | exact He ]).
      destruct (HB He') as [HΦE HΦU HΦA].
      destruct (proj2 (IHE _ _ He') (contributions_found_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_resolution _ _ _ _ He))) as [HEE HEM HEU HEA].
      constructor.
      + intros ip E0 Hr; destruct (gm_resolve_ext_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(ip' & -> & HE) | HΦ']; eauto.
      + intros z ip T pq0 D Hr.
        destruct (gm_submodule_ext_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(_ & _ & HE) | [(? & ? & _ & _ & HE) | HΦ']]; eauto.
      + intros ip pv0 A0 M0 U0 Hx.
        destruct (gm_entry_ext_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as [(ip' & -> & HE) | HΦ']; eauto.
    - (* nothing filed *)
      intros ? ? _; constructor; [ intros p E Hr; unfold gc_resolve, gc_resolve_u in Hr; cbn in Hr; discriminate
                                 | intros p D Hr; unfold ind_lookup, ind_lookup_u, ind_mlookup_u, gc_module, gc_module_u in Hr; cbn in Hr; discriminate
                                 | intros p ? ? ? ? Hr; unfold gc_entry, gc_entry_u in Hr; cbn in Hr; discriminate ].
    - (* a filed unit: it resolves as its closed frame did *)
      rename H into Hg, H0 into IHU.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He.
      destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as [_ _ [Hn _] _].
      destruct (IHU _ _ (gctx_embedding_pre _ _ _ _ _ _ (gc_sub_file _ _ U Hn) He)) as [HR HI HA].
      constructor; [ intros p E Hr; rewrite gc_resolve_file in Hr; eauto | |].
      + intros p D Hr; rewrite ind_lookup_file in Hr; eauto.
      + intros p ? ? ? ? Hr; rewrite gc_entry_file in Hr; eauto.
    - (* a frame *)
      rename H0 into IHΞ, H2 into IHU.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He.
      assert (HeΞ : gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2) by (eapply gctx_embedding_pre; [ apply gc_sub_push; eassumption | exact He ]).
      destruct (IHU _ _ HeΞ) as [HK HB]; destruct (HB He) as [HUE HUU HUA].
      destruct (IHΞ _ _ HeΞ) as [HR HI HA].
      constructor.
      + intros p E Hr; destruct (gc_resolve_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(ip & -> & Hm) | Hr']; eauto.
      + intros p D Hr; destruct (ind_lookup_module _ _ _ _ Hr) as (pq0 & [(T & Hm) | Hf]).
        * destruct (gc_module_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as [(x & ip & -> & Hm') | Hm']; [ eauto |].
          apply (HI p); rewrite (ind_lookup_body _ _ _ _ _ Hm'); reflexivity.
        * cbn [gs_find_ind] in Hf; destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[| ? ?] |] eqn:Hs; [| discriminate |].
          -- destruct K as [| pq1 k1 D1 | R1]; [ discriminate | | discriminate ]; injection Hf as -> -> ->; exact (HK _ _ eq_refl).
          -- apply (HI p); rewrite ind_lookup_unfold, ind_mlookup_unfold, Hf; reflexivity.
      + intros p ? ? ? ? Hr; destruct (gc_entry_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(ip & -> & Hm) | Hr']; eauto.
  Qed.

  Corollary global_induction : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> globals_valid Θ Ξ Θ Ξ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hg; destruct global_induction_all as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & H).
    exact (H _ _ Hg _ _ (gctx_embedding_refl _ _ Hg)).
  Qed.
End Induction.

Validity of Bodies, by Induction over Insertion

The induction of Global/Presup.v for entries, extended to what a module contributes besides its definitions: its telescope (F) and its aliases. V Θ2 Ξ2 T E is the validity at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 of an entry E other than a body module, checked over the telescope T.

Embeddings keeping bodies

The validity of modules is stated at every target that keeps their bodies (gc_sub_keeping_bodies): a body valid at the source is the one read at the target. The module of an inductive type grows while its members are checked, so each member is valid wherever the context it is checked in is (Hdef below).

Record gctx_embedding_with_bodies (Θ1 : gdeps) (Ξ1 : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) : Prop :=
  { gctx_embedding_with_bodies_wf : ⊢ᵍ Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2
  ; gctx_embedding_with_bodies_resolution : gc_sub_keeping_bodies Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 }.

Lemma gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding : forall Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 -> gctx_embedding Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2.
Proof. intros * [Hg Hs]; constructor; [ exact Hg | exact (gc_sub_keeping_bodies_sub _ _ _ _ Hs) ]. Qed.

Lemma gctx_embedding_with_bodies_refl : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ Ξ.
Proof. intros; constructor; [ assumption | apply gc_sub_keeping_bodies_refl ]. Qed.

Lemma gctx_embedding_with_bodies_pre : forall Θ1 Ξ1 Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2,
    gc_sub_keeping_bodies Θ1 Ξ1 Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2.
Proof. intros * H [Hg He]; constructor; [ assumption | eapply gc_sub_keeping_bodies_trans; eassumption ]. Qed.

What an entry contributes, its sub-bodies as they are.
Definition contributions_found_with_bodies (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (T : ctx) (mp : qname) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  contributions_found Θ2 Ξ2 T mp E /\
  (forall x (ip : list String.string) r, ge_subbody T E x ip = Some r ->
     gc_body Θ2 Ξ2 (qname_app mp (x :: ip)) = Some r).

Lemma contributions_found_with_bodies_frame : forall Θ mp K Δ Φ x E Ξ Θ2 Ξ2,
    gc_sub_keeping_bodies Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ (Φ ⊳ x ↦ E)) :: Ξ) Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    contributions_found_with_bodies Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (qname_in mp x) E.
Proof.
  intros * Hs; split; [ exact (contributions_found_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (gc_sub_keeping_bodies_sub _ _ _ _ Hs)) |].
  intros z ip0 r Hr0; rewrite qname_app_in; apply (gc_sub_keeping_bodies_body _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs).
  rewrite gc_body_frame_here; cbn [gu_mod gu_params]; apply gm_subbody_ext_here; exact Hr0.
Qed.

Lemma gctx_embedding_with_bodies_nested : forall Θ Ξ mp pv K Δ' Φ' Θ2 Ξ2,
    gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    contributions_found_with_bodies Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) mp (frame_entry pv mp K Δ' Φ') ->
    kind_tele mp K Δ' (gs_tele Ξ) ->
    gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ' Φ') :: Ξ) Θ2 Ξ2.
Proof.
  intros * He [Hc Hbod] HK; constructor; [ exact (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_wf _ _ _ _ He) | split ].
  - exact (gctx_embedding_resolution _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_nested _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) Hc HK)).
  - intros p r Hr; destruct (gc_body_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as [(x & ip & -> & Hm) | Hr'].
    + apply Hbod; rewrite (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (frame_entry_reads pv _ _ _ Φ' _ HK)))))); exact Hm.
    + exact (gc_sub_keeping_bodies_body _ _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_resolution _ _ _ _ He) Hr').
Qed.

The flag premise of the filed alias rules (wf_gentry_alias, wf_gentry_def_mod), over the full telescope Δa at ⋅, as a levels_flag.
Lemma levels_flag_of_global : forall Θ Ξ Δa E (lv : bool) Rt,
    (lv = true -> level_sorted_parameters Δa) ->
    (lv = false -> mdenote Θ Ξ Δa E Rt) -> (lv = false -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ⊢ⁿˡ Rt) ->
    levels_flag Θ Ξ ⋅ Δa E lv Rt.
Proof. intros * H1 H2 H3; constructor; [ exact H1 | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact H2 | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact H3 ]. Qed.

Section ModInduction.
The validity of an entry, read from a source context, at a target it embeds into.
  Variable V : gdeps -> gstack -> gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> gentry -> Prop.
  Variable F : gdeps -> gstack -> ctx -> Prop.
The validity of the declaration of an inductive type.
  Variable VD : gdeps -> gstack -> ind_decl -> Prop.
The validity of the declaration of a record type.
  Variable VR : gdeps -> gstack -> record_decl -> Prop.

A body is valid when its definitions and aliases are, and its body modules and the modules of its inductive and record types are, over their telescopes; the declaration of an inductive or a record type is valid too.
  Fixpoint gm_valid (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (T : ctx) (Φ : gmod) : Prop :=
    match Φ with
    | gm_nil => True
    (* only filed bodies are read, and they have no local open *)
    | gm_open Φ0 _ _ _ => gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ0
    | gm_ext Φ0 _ (ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ'))) =>
        gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ0 /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ T) /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ T) Φ'
    | gm_ext Φ0 _ (ge_ind _ _ k D Φ') =>
        gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ0 /\ (k = 0 -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D) /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D) /\
        gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D) Φ'
    | gm_ext Φ0 _ (ge_def_mod pv A M U) =>
        gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ0 /\ V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_mod pv U) /\ V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_def true pv ak_relevant A (Some M)) /\
        (exists A0 i, A = ctx_pi T A0 /\ Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ T ⊢ A0 : Typeω@i)
    | gm_ext Φ0 _ (ge_record pv pr R Φ') =>
        gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ0 /\ VR Θ2 Ξ2 R /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (record_mod_tele pr R) /\
        gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (record_mod_tele pr R) Φ'
    | gm_ext Φ0 _ E => gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ0 /\ V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T E
    end.

What the entry E, filed over T, contributes is valid: as gm_valid does for one entry of a body.
  Definition ge_valid (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (T : ctx) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
    match E with
    | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ')) => F Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ T) /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ T) Φ'
    
The group is valid at its first member.
    | ge_ind _ _ k D Φ' => (k = 0 -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D) /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D) /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D) Φ'
    
A definition with a module part is valid as its two views: its module part, a module alias, and its term part, a transparent definition. A definition with a module part has a universe-typed term part (wf_gentry_def_mod); stored separately because the term view's stored_def_typed admits any relevant sort.
    | ge_def_mod pv A M U =>
        V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_mod pv U) /\ V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_def true pv ak_relevant A (Some M)) /\
        (exists A0 i, A = ctx_pi T A0 /\ Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ T ⊢ A0 : Typeω@i)
    
A record is valid as its declaration, and its module as a body over its parameters and a value.
    | ge_record pv pr R Φ' =>
        VR Θ2 Ξ2 R /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (record_mod_tele pr R) /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (record_mod_tele pr R) Φ'
    | _ => V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T E
    end.

  Lemma gm_valid_ext : forall Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ x E,
      gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (Φ ⊳ x ↦ E) <-> gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ /\ ge_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T E.
  Proof. intros; destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ' | E']] | ? ? ? ? ? | ? Aa Ma Ua | ? pr Rr ΦR]; cbn; tauto. Qed.

The group a frame's kind names, if the frame is the module of the group's first member, is valid at Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2; so is the record type whose module the frame is.
  Definition kind_valid (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (K : frame_kind) : Prop :=
    (forall pq D, K = fk_ind pq 0 D -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D) /\ (forall R, K = fk_record R -> VR Θ2 Ξ2 R).

  Fixpoint gs_valid (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
    match Ξ with
    | nil => True
    | (_, K, U) :: Ξ' =>
        F Θ2 Ξ2 (gu_params U ++ gs_tele Ξ') /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (gu_params U ++ gs_tele Ξ') (gu_mod U) /\
        kind_valid Θ2 Ξ2 K /\ gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ'
    end.

  Definition gds_valid (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack) (Θ2 : gdeps) (Ξ2 : gstack) (Θ : gdeps) : Prop :=
    forall fp U, gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U -> F Θ2 Ξ2 (gu_params U) /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (gu_params U) (gu_mod U).

Everything filed or open at Θ ⍮ Ξ is valid wherever Θ ⍮ Ξ embeds, read from any context that has what Θ ⍮ Ξ has.
  Definition bodies_valid_along_embeddings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
    forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> forall Θs Ξs, gc_sub Θ Ξ Θs Ξs -> gds_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Θ /\ gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ.

A definition is checked in a closed telescope T: the frames' parameters, or the uniform parameters of the inductive type whose module it is a member of. It is valid wherever what the context it is checked in files and has open is valid, read from there, along any growth; it is so read from anywhere.
  Hypothesis Hdef : forall Θ Ξ T r A M i b pv Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
      (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters T) ->
      
The telescope is of assumptions, so that the definition's filed body has no let at a type of levels (ctx_pi_type_kind)
      all_assumptions T ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ M : A -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> gds_valid Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
      forall Θs Ξs, V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r T A) (Some (ctx_fn T M))).
The other entries are valid read from any context that has what the context they are checked in has.
  Hypothesis Hax : forall Θ Ξ r A i b pv Θ2 Ξ2 Θs Ξs,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
      
No axiom is of a type of levels
      r <> ak_level ->
      
The frames' parameters are assumptions (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions)
      all_assumptions (gs_tele Ξ) ->
      bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> gc_sub Θ Ξ Θs Ξs ->
      V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r (gs_tele Ξ) A) None).
  Hypothesis Halias : forall Θ Ξ pv Δ E l (lv : bool) Rt Θ2 Ξ2 Θs Ξs,
      all_assumptions Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
      params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
      levels_flag Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E lv Rt ->
      frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E ->
      bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> gc_sub Θ Ξ Θs Ξs ->
      V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) (ge_mod pv (gu_mk (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias E))).
  Hypothesis Hnil : forall Θ Ξ Δ l Θ2 Ξ2,
      all_assumptions Δ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
      bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      F Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ).
A declaration, and the telescope of its uniform parameters, which its module's members are checked in.
  Hypothesis Hind : forall Θ Ξ D l Θ2 Ξ2,
      decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (ind_uparams D) l ->
      bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D).
A record's declaration, with its parameters relevant, at any target its context embeds into.
  Hypothesis Hrecord : forall Θ Ξ R l Θ2 Ξ2,
      record_typed Θ Ξ R -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (record_params R) l ->
      bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> VR Θ2 Ξ2 R.
A record's module telescope, at any target its context embeds into where the record is found: its parameters, then a value of it, which is typed only there.
  Hypothesis Hrecord_tele : forall Θ Ξ p R Θ2 Ξ2,
      record_typed Θ Ξ R -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> record_lookup Θ2 Ξ2 p = Some R ->
      F Θ2 Ξ2 (record_params R) -> F Θ2 Ξ2 (record_mod_tele p R).

An entry, and the context it is checked in: valid read from any context that has it and what the context it is checked in has.
  Definition entry_bodies_valid_along_embeddings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ /\
    (forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> forall pv pq D Φ, E = ge_ind pv pq 0 D Φ -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D) /\
    forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> contributions_found_with_bodies Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) mp E ->
      forall Θs Ξs, gc_sub Θ Ξ Θs Ξs -> contributions_found Θs Ξs (gs_tele Ξ) mp E -> ge_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) E.

A module, and the context it is checked in: the group its kind names is valid wherever the context embeds, and its body is valid read from any context that has its frame.
  Definition module_bodies_valid_along_embeddings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (K : frame_kind) (Δ : ctx) (Φ : gmod) : Prop :=
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ /\
    (forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> kind_valid Θ2 Ξ2 K) /\
    forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) Θ2 Ξ2 -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      F Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) /\
      forall Θs Ξs, gc_sub Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) Θs Ξs -> gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) Φ.

  Theorem global_valid_all :
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ Γ R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R -> True) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> entry_bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ mp E) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> module_bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ) /\
    (forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ).
  Proof.
    apply wf_mut_ind_all; intros; try assumption; try exact I.
    - (* a definition or an axiom *)
      split; [ assumption |]; split; [ intros ? ? _ ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He _ Θs Ξs Hs _; cbn.
      (* the frames' parameters are assumptions *)
      match goal with HA : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ gs_tele _ ⊢ _ : _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx HA))) as Hta end.
      match goal with
      | HM : forall M, ?o = Some M -> _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ M : _, IHM : forall M, ?o = Some M -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct o as [M0 |]; cbn;
          [ destruct (IHM M0 eq_refl _ _ He _ _ (gc_sub_refl _ _)) as [HΘ HΞ];
            eapply Hdef; [ eassumption | eassumption | exact Hta | exact (HM M0 eq_refl) | exact (IHM M0 eq_refl)
                         | exact (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) | exact HΘ | exact HΞ ]
          | eapply Hax; first [ eassumption
                              | match goal with Hn : None = None -> _ <> ak_level |- _ => exact (Hn eq_refl) end ] ]
      end.
    - (* a body module: valid as its frame, pushed, is *)
      destruct H0 as [HG [_ HM]]; split; [ exact HG |]; split; [ intros ? ? _ ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He Hc Θs Ξs Hs Hcs; cbn.
      destruct (HM _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_nested _ _ _ pv fk_module _ _ _ _ He Hc I) He) as [HF HΦ].
      split; [ exact HF | apply HΦ; exact (gc_sub_nested _ _ _ pv fk_module _ _ _ _ Hs Hcs I) ].
    - split; [ assumption |]; split; [ intros ? ? _ ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He _ Θs Ξs Hs _; cbn; eapply Halias;
        first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption | eapply levels_flag_of_global; eassumption ].
    - (* a group, at its first member, with no member in its module *)
      split; [ assumption |].
      assert (HRU : exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (ind_uparams D) l).
      { match goal with HU : ind_uparams D = ?Δ ++ gs_tele ?Ξ0, HC : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ind_uparams D |- _ =>
          rewrite HU; eapply params_evaluated_over_stack;
            [ exact (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HC) | first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ] ] end. }
      destruct HRU as [lU HRU].
      assert (HDF : forall Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D /\ F Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D))
        by (intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; eapply Hind; [ build_decl_typed | exact HRU | eassumption | exact He ]).
      split; [ intros Θ2 Ξ2 He ? ? ? ? Heq; injection Heq as _ _ <- _; exact (proj1 (HDF _ _ He)) |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He _ Θs Ξs _ _; cbn.
      destruct (HDF _ _ He) as [HD HF].
      repeat split; [ intros _; exact HD | exact HF ].
    - (* a later declared member of a group, before the members of its
         module: over the group's uniform parameters *)
      split; [ assumption |]; split; [ intros ? ? _ ? ? ? ? Heq; injection Heq as _ _ Hk0 _ _; lia |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He _ Θs Ξs _ _; cbn.
      split; [ intros; lia | split; [| exact I ] ].
      match goal with
      | HU : ind_uparams ?D = ?Δu ++ gs_tele ?Ξ', Ha : all_assumptions (ind_uparams ?D), HC : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ind_uparams ?D,
        HG : bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ |- F _ _ (ind_uparams ?D) =>
          rewrite HU in Ha, HC |- *; eapply Hnil;
            [ exact (proj1 (proj1 (List.Forall_app _ _ _) Ha)) | exact HC
            | first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ] | exact HG | exact He ]
      end.
    - (* a declared member with the body of its module, checked in the
         member's open frame *)
      match goal with IH : module_bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHM end.
      match goal with Hu : ind_uparams D = _ |- _ => rename Hu into HU end.
      destruct IHM as [HG [HK IHM]]; split; [ exact HG |].
      split; [ intros Θ2 Ξ2 He ? ? ? ? Heq; injection Heq as _ <- -> <- _; exact (proj1 (HK _ _ He) _ _ eq_refl) |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He Hc Θs Ξs Hs Hcs; cbn.
      destruct (IHM _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_nested _ _ _ pv (fk_ind pq k D) _ _ _ _ He Hc HU) He) as [HF HΦ].
      rewrite HU; split; [ intros ->; exact (proj1 (HK _ _ He) _ _ eq_refl) | split; [ exact HF |] ].
      apply HΦ; exact (gc_sub_nested _ _ _ pv (fk_ind pq k D) _ _ _ _ Hs Hcs HU).
    - (* a definition with a module part: valid as its module part, an
         alias, and as its term part, a transparent definition *)
      split; [ assumption |]; split; [ intros ? ? _ ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He _ Θs Ξs Hs _; cbn; split;
        [ eapply Halias; first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption
                               | eapply levels_flag_of_global; eassumption ] |].
      match goal with HG : bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ |- _ => destruct (HG _ _ He _ _ (gc_sub_refl _ _)) as [HΘ HΞ] end.
      split.
      2:{ (* its term part's type is of a universe, moved along the embedding *)
          destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He)) as (_ & Ht & _).
          do 2 eexists; split; [ reflexivity | apply Ht; eassumption ]. }
      match goal with HA : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ gs_tele _ ⊢ _ : _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx HA))) as Hta end.
      eapply (Hdef _ _ _ ak_relevant); [ eassumption | discriminate | exact Hta | eassumption | eassumption
                                   | exact (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) | exact HΘ | exact HΞ ].
    - (* a record, before the members of its module: valid as its
         declaration, over its parameters and a value *)
      split; [ assumption |]; split; [ intros ? ? _ ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He [Hct _] Θs Ξs Hs _; cbn.
      assert (HRr : exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (record_params R) l).
      { match goal with HU : record_params R = ?Δ ++ gs_tele ?Ξ0, HS : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ record_params R ⊢ᵤ _,
                        Hp : forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, ?Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ T : _ |- _ =>
          rewrite HU; eapply params_evaluated_over_stack;
            [ exact (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_is_univ_ctx HS))
            | first [ exact Hp | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; [ eassumption | exact Hp ] ] ] end. }
      destruct HRr as [lR HRr].
      split; [ eapply Hrecord; [ constructor; eassumption | exact HRr | eassumption | exact He ] | split; [| exact I ] ].
      eapply Hrecord_tele; [ constructor; eassumption | eassumption | exact He | exact (contributions_found_record_lookup _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hct) |].
      match goal with
      | HU : record_params ?R = ?Δu ++ gs_tele ?Ξ', Ha : all_assumptions (record_params ?R),
        HS : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ record_params ?R ⊢ᵤ _, HG : bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ |- F _ _ (record_params ?R) =>
          pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx HS) as HC;
          rewrite HU in Ha, HC |- *; eapply Hnil;
            [ exact (proj1 (proj1 (List.Forall_app _ _ _) Ha)) | exact HC
            | first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ] | exact HG | exact He ]
      end.
    - (* a record with the body of its module, checked in the record's open
         frame *)
      match goal with IH : module_bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHM end.
      match goal with Hu : record_params R = _ |- _ => rename Hu into HU end.
      match goal with Hm : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_record R ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ _ |- _ => pose proof (wf_gmod_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm _ eq_refl) as HRt end.
      destruct IHM as [HG [HK IHM]]; split; [ exact HG |].
      split; [ intros Θ2 Ξ2 He ? ? ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He Hc Θs Ξs Hs Hcs; cbn.
      assert (HKt : kind_tele mp (fk_record R) (ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self mp R) :: Δ) (gs_tele Ξ))
        by (exists Δ; split; [ reflexivity | exact HU ]).
      destruct (IHM _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_nested _ _ _ pv (fk_record R) _ _ _ _ He Hc HKt) He) as [HF HΦ].
      split; [ exact (proj2 (HK _ _ He) _ eq_refl) |].
      unfold record_mod_tele; rewrite HU; split; [ exact HF |].
      apply HΦ; exact (gc_sub_nested _ _ _ pv (fk_record R) _ _ _ _ Hs Hcs HKt).
    - split; [ assumption |]; split; [ intros ? ? _; split; [ intros ? ? Heq | intros ? Heq ]; discriminate Heq |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 _ He; split; [ eapply Hnil; first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ] | intros; exact I ].
    - (* the module of a member, before its members: the member's group *)
      match goal with IH : entry_bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHE end.
      split; [ exact (proj1 IHE) |]; split.
      + intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split; [| intros ? Heq; discriminate Heq ].
        intros pq0 D0 Heq; injection Heq as -> -> ->; exact (proj1 (proj2 IHE) _ _ He _ _ _ _ eq_refl).
      + intros Θ2 Ξ2 _ He; split; [ eapply Hnil; first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ] | intros; exact I ].
    - (* the module of a record, before its members: the record's
         declaration *)
      match goal with IH : entry_bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHE end.
      split; [ exact (proj1 IHE) |]; split.
      + intros Θ2 Ξ2 He; split; [ intros ? ? Heq; discriminate Heq |].
        intros R0 Heq; injection Heq as <-.
        match goal with HE : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ ge_record _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (wf_gentry_record_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE) as [lR HRr];
          exact (Hrecord _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj1 wf_record_typed_all _ _ _ _ HE _ _ _ _ eq_refl) HRr (proj1 IHE) He) end.
      + (* its telescope: the parameters, valid one frame out, and the
           value, where the record's frame is *)
        intros Θ2 Ξ2 Hp He; split; [| intros; exact I ].
        match goal with HE : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ ge_record _ _ _ _, HU : record_params _ = _ ++ _ |- _ =>
          pose proof (proj1 wf_record_typed_all _ _ _ _ HE _ _ _ _ eq_refl) as HRt; cbn [List.app]; rewrite <- HU end.
        eapply Hrecord_tele; [ exact HRt | exact (proj1 IHE) | exact He | |].
        * apply (gc_sub_frame_record _ _ _ _ _ _ (gc_sub_keeping_bodies_sub _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_resolution _ _ _ _ Hp))).
          rewrite gs_find_record_own; reflexivity.
        * match goal with HU : record_params _ = _ ++ _ |- _ => rewrite HU end.
          match goal with Ha : all_assumptions ?Δ, HC : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Δ ++ _ |- _ => exact (Hnil _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha HC
                   ltac:(first [ eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ]) (proj1 IHE) He) end.
    - match goal with IH : module_bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHΦ end.
      match goal with IH : entry_bodies_valid_along_embeddings _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename IH into IHE end.
      destruct IHΦ as [HG [HK IHΦ]]; split; [ exact HG |]; split; [ exact HK |].
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He Hout.
      assert (He' : gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ ((mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) Θ2 Ξ2)
        by (eapply gctx_embedding_with_bodies_pre; [ apply gc_sub_keeping_bodies_grow; eassumption | exact He ]).
      destruct (IHΦ _ _ He' Hout) as [HF HΦ].
      split; [ exact HF |]; intros Θs Ξs Hs.
      apply gm_valid_ext; split; [ apply HΦ; eapply gc_sub_trans; [ apply gc_sub_grow; eassumption | exact Hs ] |].
      apply (proj2 (proj2 IHE) _ _ He' (contributions_found_with_bodies_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_resolution _ _ _ _ He))).
      + eapply gc_sub_trans; [ apply gc_sub_grow; eassumption | exact Hs ].
      + exact (contributions_found_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs).
    - intros Θ2 Ξ2 _ Θs Ξs _; split; [ intros fp U Hl; discriminate | exact I ].
    - (* a filed unit: valid as its closed frame was *)
      rename H into Hg, H0 into IHU.
      match goal with |- bodies_valid_along_embeddings ((?f, _) :: _) nil => rename f into fp0 end.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He Θs Ξs Hs; split; [| exact I ].
      destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as [_ _ [Hn _] _].
      destruct (IHU Θ2 Ξ2 ltac:(eapply gctx_embedding_with_bodies_pre; [ apply gc_sub_keeping_bodies_file; exact Hn | exact He ])
                  Θs Ξs ltac:(eapply gc_sub_trans; [ apply gc_sub_file; exact Hn | exact Hs ])) as [HΘ HΞ].
      intros fq W Hl; cbn in Hl; destruct (path_beq fq fp0);
        [ injection Hl as <-; cbn [gs_valid gs_tele] in HΞ; rewrite app_nil_r in HΞ; tauto | exact (HΘ _ _ Hl) ].
    - rename H0 into IHΞ, H2 into IHU.
      intros Θ2 Ξ2 He Θs Ξs Hs.
      assert (He0 : gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2) by (eapply gctx_embedding_with_bodies_pre; [ apply gc_sub_keeping_bodies_push; eassumption | exact He ]).
      destruct (IHΞ _ _ He0 Θs Ξs ltac:(eapply gc_sub_trans; [ apply gc_sub_push; eassumption | exact Hs ])) as [HΘ HΞ].
      split; [ exact HΘ |].
      destruct (proj2 (proj2 IHU) _ _ He He0) as [HF HΦ]; cbn [gs_valid].
      split; [ exact HF | split; [ apply HΦ; exact Hs | split; [ exact (proj1 (proj2 IHU) _ _ He0) | exact HΞ ] ] ].
  Qed.

  Corollary global_valid : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings Θ Ξ.
  Proof. intros; apply global_valid_all; assumption. Qed.

Reading validity back


  Lemma gm_valid_subbody : forall Φ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T x ip T' Φ',
      gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ -> gm_subbody T Φ x ip = Some (T', Φ') -> F Θ2 Ξ2 T' /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T' Φ'.
  Proof.
    fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate | | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H) ].
    destruct (String.eqb x y);
      [| destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? ? ? | ? Aa Ma Ua | ? Rr ΦR]; (eapply IH; [ exact (proj1 Hv) | exact H ]) ].
    destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? D Φ0 | ? Aa Ma Ua | ? Rr ΦR]; try discriminate.
    - destruct Hv as (_ & HF & Hv); destruct ip as [| w ip].
      + injection H as <- <-; split; assumption.
      + exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & HF & Hv); destruct ip as [| w ip].
      + injection H as <- <-; split; assumption.
      + exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & HF & Hv); destruct ip as [| w ip].
      + injection H as <- <-; split; assumption.
      + exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
  Qed.

  Lemma gm_valid_body : forall Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ ip T' Φ',
      F Θ2 Ξ2 T -> gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ -> gm_body T Φ ip = Some (T', Φ') -> F Θ2 Ξ2 T' /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T' Φ'.
  Proof.
    intros * HF Hv H; destruct ip as [| x ip]; cbn in H;
      [ injection H as <- <-; split; assumption | exact (gm_valid_subbody _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H) ].
  Qed.

  Lemma gm_valid_alias : forall Φ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T x ip U,
      gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ -> gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some (mr_alias U) -> exists T' pv, V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T' (ge_mod pv U).
  Proof.
    fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate | | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H) ].
    destruct (String.eqb x y);
      [| destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? ? ? | ? Aa Ma Ua | ? Rr ΦR]; (eapply IH; [ exact (proj1 Hv) | exact H ]) ].
    destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | pm [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? D Φ0 | pm Aa Ma [Δa [? Φa | Ea]] | pm Rr ΦR]; try discriminate.
    - destruct ip as [| w ip]; [ discriminate |].
      destruct Hv as (_ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct ip; [| discriminate ]; injection H as <-; exists T, pm; exact (proj2 Hv).
    - destruct ip as [| w ip]; [ discriminate |].
      destruct Hv as (_ & _ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct ip; [| discriminate ]; injection H as <-; exists T, pm; exact (proj1 (proj2 Hv)).
    - destruct ip as [| w ip]; [ discriminate |].
      destruct Hv as (_ & _ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
  Qed.

  Lemma gm_valid_ind : forall Φ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T x ip T' pq D,
      gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ -> gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some (mr_body T' (Some (pq, 0, D))) -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D.
  Proof.
    fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E | Φ c] * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate | | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H) ].
    destruct (String.eqb x y);
      [| destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? ? ? | ? Aa Ma Ua | ? Rr ΦR]; (eapply IH; [ exact (proj1 Hv) | exact H ]) ].
    destruct E as [? ? ? ? ? | pm [Δ [? Φ0 | E0]] | ? ? ? D0 Φ0 | pm Aa Ma [Δa [? Φa | Ea]] | pm Rr ΦR]; try discriminate;
      destruct ip as [| w ip]; try discriminate.
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - injection H; intros; subst; exact (proj1 (proj2 Hv) eq_refl).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
  Qed.

A record entry of a valid body is valid as its declaration.
  Lemma gm_valid_record : forall Φ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T ip pv pr R Φ',
      gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ -> gm_entry Φ ip = Some (ge_record pv pr R Φ') -> VR Θ2 Ξ2 R.
  Proof.
    fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E0 | Φ c] * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate | | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H) ].
    destruct ip as [| x ip]; [ discriminate |].
    destruct (String.eqb x y);
      [| destruct E0 as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ [? Φ0 | E1]] | ? ? ? ? ? | ? Aa Ma Ua | ? pr0 Rr ΦR]; (eapply IH; [ exact (proj1 Hv) | exact H ]) ].
    destruct ip as [| w ip], E0 as [? ? ? ? ? | ? [Δ0 [? Φ0 | E1]] | ? ? ? D Φ0 | pm Aa Ma Ua | pm pr0 Rr ΦR]; cbn in H; try discriminate.
    - injection H as <- <- <- <-; exact (proj1 (proj2 Hv)).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct Hv as (_ & _ & _ & Hv); exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
  Qed.

  Lemma gs_valid_find : forall Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ p U ip T,
      gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ -> gs_find_tele Ξ p = Some (U, ip, T) ->
      F Θ2 Ξ2 (gu_params U ++ T) /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 (gu_params U ++ T) (gu_mod U).
  Proof.
    induction Ξ as [| [[mp K0] U0] Ξ IH]; intros * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate |].
    destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ injection H as <- <- <-; split; apply Hv | exact (IH _ _ _ _ (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hv))) H) ].
  Qed.

The group an open frame's kind names, at its first member, is valid.
  Lemma gs_valid_kind : forall Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ p pq D,
      gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ -> gs_find_ind Ξ p = Some (pq, 0, D) -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D.
  Proof.
    induction Ξ as [| [[mp K0] U0] Ξ IH]; intros * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate |].
    destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[| ? ?] |]; [| discriminate | exact (IH _ _ _ (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hv))) H) ].
    destruct K0 as [| pq' k' D' | R']; [ discriminate | | discriminate ]; injection H as -> -> ->.
    exact (proj1 (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hv))) _ _ eq_refl).
  Qed.

The record type whose module an open frame is, is valid.
  Lemma gs_valid_record_kind : forall Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ p R,
      gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ -> gs_find_record Ξ p = Some R -> VR Θ2 Ξ2 R.
  Proof.
    induction Ξ as [| [[mp K0] U0] Ξ IH]; intros * Hv H; cbn in Hv, H; [ discriminate |].
    destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[| ? ?] |]; [| discriminate | exact (IH _ _ (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hv))) H) ].
    destruct K0 as [| pq' k' D' | R']; try discriminate; injection H as ->.
    exact (proj2 (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hv))) _ eq_refl).
  Qed.

  Lemma gc_body_valid : forall Θ Ξ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 p T Φ, gds_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
      gc_body Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> F Θ2 Ξ2 T /\ gm_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ.
  Proof.
    intros * HΘ HΞ H; unfold gc_body in H.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T0] |] eqn:Hf; [ discriminate | |].
    - destruct (gs_valid_find _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf) as [HF Hv]; exact (gm_valid_subbody _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:Hl; [| discriminate ].
      destruct (HΘ _ _ Hl) as [HF Hv]; exact (gm_valid_body _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HF Hv H).
  Qed.

A filed record entry is valid as its declaration.
  Lemma gc_record_entry_valid : forall Θ Ξ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 p pv pr R Φ', gds_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
      gc_entry Θ Ξ p = Some (ge_record pv pr R Φ') -> VR Θ2 Ξ2 R.
  Proof.
    intros * HΘ HΞ H; unfold gc_entry, gc_entry_u in H.
    rewrite gs_find_tele_find in H.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U ip] T0] |] eqn:Hf; cbn in H.
    - destruct (gs_valid_find _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf) as [_ Hv]; exact (gm_valid_record _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:Hl; [| discriminate ].
      destruct (HΘ _ _ Hl) as [_ Hv]; exact (gm_valid_record _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
  Qed.

A record type a path names, filed or with its module's frame open, is valid.
  Lemma record_lookup_valid : forall Θ Ξ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 p R, gds_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
      record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R -> VR Θ2 Ξ2 R.
  Proof.
    intros * HΘ HΞ H; unfold record_lookup in H.
    destruct (gs_find_record Ξ p) as [R' |] eqn:Hf; [ injection H as <-; exact (gs_valid_record_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf) |].
    destruct (gc_entry Θ Ξ p) as [[| | | | pv pr R' Φ'] |] eqn:He; try discriminate; injection H as <-.
    exact (gc_record_entry_valid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘ HΞ He).
  Qed.

  Lemma gc_module_alias_valid : forall Θ Ξ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 p U, gds_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
      gc_module Θ Ξ p = Some (mr_alias U) -> exists T pv, V Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_mod pv U).
  Proof.
    intros * HΘ HΞ H; unfold gc_module, gc_module_u in H.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[Uf [| x ip]] T0] |] eqn:Hf; [ discriminate | |].
    - destruct (gs_valid_find _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf) as [_ Hv]; exact (gm_valid_alias _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
    - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [Uf |] eqn:Hl; [| discriminate ].
      destruct (HΘ _ _ Hl) as [_ Hv].
      destruct (q_chain p) as [| x ip]; [ discriminate |]; exact (gm_valid_alias _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H).
  Qed.

  Lemma ind_lookup_valid : forall Θ Ξ Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 p D, gds_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> VD Θ2 Ξ2 D.
  Proof.
    intros * HΘ HΞ H.
    destruct (ind_lookup_module _ _ _ _ H) as (pq & [(T & H') | Hf]); [| exact (gs_valid_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf) ].
    unfold gc_module, gc_module_u in H'.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T0] |] eqn:Hf; [ discriminate | |].
    - destruct (gs_valid_find _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Hf) as [_ Hv]; exact (gm_valid_ind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H').
    - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:Hl; [| discriminate ].
      destruct (HΘ _ _ Hl) as [_ Hv].
      destruct (q_chain p) as [| x ip]; [ discriminate |]; exact (gm_valid_ind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv H').
  Qed.
End ModInduction.

The Syntactic Validity of Storage

A definition is stored generalized over the telescope of its module, from a typed body under it; an alias's target denotes, wherever it is read, a typed module description; an inductive alias names an inductive type at typed arguments. The telescopes of modules are well formed, and declarations of inductive types typed (decl_typed).

#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record syn_F (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (T : ctx) : Prop := mk_syn_F
  {
The telescope is of assumptions
    syn_F_ass : all_assumptions T
    
It is a well-formed context
  ; syn_F_wf : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T
    
A level containing every parameter type
  ; syn_F_level : nat
    
The parameters are types of the universe at that level, as every module's are (R)
  ; syn_F_evaluated : params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil T syn_F_level }.

Definition syn_VD : gdeps -> gstack -> ind_decl -> Prop := decl_typed.

Definition syn_VR : gdeps -> gstack -> record_decl -> Prop := record_typed.

type_of_kind Θ Ξ Δ L r A: the type A, in Δ, is of the sort of the kind r next to a large universe (a type of the universe, a proposition, a type of levels); of the types of levels only when L holds (its parameters are types of levels).
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record type_of_kind (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Δ : ctx) (L : Prop) (r : abs_kind) (A : typ) : Prop :=
  mk_type_of_kind
  {
The level of the universe next to which the sort is
    type_of_kind_level : nat
    
The types of levels only when L holds
  ; type_of_kind_levels : r = ak_level -> L
    
The type is of the sort of its kind
  ; type_of_kind_typed : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@type_of_kind_level }.

The type A0 of a definition stored over the telescope T: of the sort of its kind, a type of levels only over parameters of types of levels (wf_gentry_def).
Definition stored_def_typed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (T : ctx) (r : abs_kind) (A0 : typ) : Prop :=
  type_of_kind Θ Ξ T (level_sorted_parameters T) r A0.

The syntactic validity of a stored entry, filed over T: a definition is closed over T by Πs at its tag, from a type of the sort at its tag and a typed body under it; a module alias's target is well formed and denotes typed module descriptions, under its flag premise. A definition with a module part is valid as these two views (ge_valid).
Definition syn_V (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (T : ctx) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_def _ _ r A oM =>
      exists A0, A = ctx_pi_at r T A0 /\ stored_def_typed Θ Ξ T r A0 /\
        (forall M, oM = Some M -> exists M0, M = ctx_fn T M0 /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ M0 : A0)
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δa (md_alias E')) =>
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ⊢ᵐ E' ≈ E' /\ ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa /\
      (exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil Δa l) /\
      
The flag premise of wf_gentry_alias: the full telescope is of types of levels, or the target has no member of a type of levels
      (exists (lv : bool) Rt, levels_flag Θ Ξ ⋅ Δa E' lv Rt) /\
      forall Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ->
        (exists R, mdenote Θ Ξ (Δa ++ Γ) E' R) /\
        forall R, mdenote Θ Ξ (Δa ++ Γ) E' R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ (Δa ++ Γ) R /\ (exists Rm, mdesc_mod R = Some Rm) /\
          
and it is no module still being defined (frame_free_target)
          ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ R
  | ge_record _ _ R _ => record_typed Θ Ξ R
  | _ => True
  end.

Syntactic validity does not depend on where it is read from.
Abbreviation syn_Vs := (fun (_ : gdeps) (_ : gstack) => syn_V).

Everything stored at Θ ⍮ Ξ is valid there.
Definition valid_syn (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
  gds_valid syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ Θ Ξ Θ /\ gs_valid syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ Θ Ξ Ξ.

Lemma gm_valid_prefix : forall V F VD VR Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ y Φ0 E,
    gm_valid V F VD VR Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T Φ -> gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> ge_valid V F VD VR Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T E.
Proof.
  intros V F VD VR Θs Ξs Θ2 Ξ2 T; induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E0 | Φ IH H its]; intros * Hv Hp; cbn in Hp; [ discriminate | |].
  - apply gm_valid_ext in Hv as [Hv HE].
    destruct (String.eqb y x); [ injection Hp as -> -> ->; exact HE | eauto ].
  - destruct (existsb _ _); [ discriminate | cbn in Hv; eauto ].
Qed.

Lemma loc_valid : forall Θ Ξ p T Φ, valid_syn Θ Ξ -> loc Θ Ξ p T Φ ->
    syn_F Θ Ξ T /\ gm_valid syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ Θ Ξ T Φ.
Proof.
  intros * [HΘ HΞ] [Hl | Hl].
  - unfold gc_frame in Hl.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] [| ? ?]] T0] |] eqn:Ef; try discriminate.
    injection Hl as <- <-; exact (gs_valid_find _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΞ Ef).
  - exact (gc_body_valid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘ HΞ Hl).
Qed.

A stored module's telescope is of relevant parameters.
Corollary loc_params_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ p T Φ, valid_syn Θ Ξ -> loc Θ Ξ p T Φ -> exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil T l.
Proof. intros * Hv Hl; destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ Hv Hl) as [[_ _ l HR] _]; exists l; exact HR. Qed.

The record type an open frame is the module of is typed: it was checked where the module started.
Lemma record_frame_typed : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p R, gs_find_record Ξ p = Some R -> record_typed Θ Ξ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hf.
  destruct (gs_find_record_split _ _ _ Hf) as (Ξ1 & U & Ξ0 & HΞ & _); subst Ξ.
  destruct (wf_gstack_app_inv _ _ _ Hg) as [Hg0 Hsub].
  destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg0) as [_ [Δ Φ0 -> HΦ] Hff _].
  eapply gctx_embedding_preserves_record_typed; [| exact (wf_gmod_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ _ eq_refl) ].
  constructor; [ exact Hg | eapply gc_sub_trans; [ apply gc_sub_push; exact Hff | exact Hsub ] ].
Qed.

Over valid storage, every record type found is typed.
Lemma record_lookup_typed : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> forall p R,
    record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R -> record_typed Θ Ξ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg [HΘ HΞ] * Hl; unfold record_lookup in Hl.
  destruct (gs_find_record Ξ p) as [R0 |] eqn:Hf; [ injection Hl as <-; exact (record_frame_typed _ _ Hg _ _ Hf) |].
  destruct (gc_entry Θ Ξ p) as [[| | | | pv pr R0 Φ] |] eqn:He; try discriminate; injection Hl as <-.
  exact (gc_record_entry_valid syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘ HΞ He).
Qed.

An axiom or an abstract definition stored in a stored body is a member of the body's path, at the type it is stored at: read bare, it has no δ-reduct.
Lemma filed_def_wf : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ p T Φ y Φ0 b pv r A oM Srt,
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> loc Θ Ξ p T Φ -> gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv r A oM)) ->
    (if b then oM else None) = None ->
    type_sort Srt -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem (qname_mod p) y : A.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * HΓ Hl Hp Hn HS HA.
  destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ nil (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl)) as (R1 & Hm & Hmd); cbn [me_apps] in Hm.
  eapply wf_mem; [ exact (loc_modexp_wf _ _ _ HΓ _ _ _ Hl) | | | exact HA | exact HS | ].
  - eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm | exact Hmd | cbn; rewrite Hp; reflexivity | constructor | reflexivity ].
  - destruct b, oM; reflexivity.
  - intros M Hr0; rewrite mdesc_named_nil in Hr0; cbn in Hr0; rewrite Hn in Hr0; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_ats_some_red : forall Ns r A M R, mdesc_ats (mdesc_term r A (Some M)) Ns = Some R -> exists A' M', R = mdesc_term r A' (Some M').
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * Ha; cbn in Ha; [ injection Ha as <-; eauto |].
  destruct (pi_view A) as [[? ?] |]; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (fn_view M) as [M' |]; [ exact (IH _ _ _ _ Ha) | discriminate ].
Qed.

Members of No Type of Levels, Read from a Closed Module

Over a telescope of assumptions, the Πs closing a type determine it.
Lemma ctx_pi_at_ass_injective : forall r T A B, all_assumptions T -> ctx_pi_at r T A = ctx_pi_at r T B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros r; induction T as [| e T IH]; intros * Ha E; cbn in E; [ exact E |].
  apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Ha as [(κC & C & ->) Ha']; cbn in E.
  apply IH in E; [ injection E as E; exact E | exact Ha' ].
Qed.

A description with no member of a type of levels, read as a name: only a term's δ-reduct changes.
Lemma no_level_named : forall Θ Ξ Γ Θ' Ns M R,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_named Θ' Ns M R.
Proof.
  intros * H; apply mdesc_named_cases; [ exact H |].
  destruct R as [r A [|] | | |]; cbn [mdesc_self]; first [ exact H | exact (no_level_term_any _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H) ].
Qed.

A definition of a closed module with no member of a type of levels is not of the kind of levels.
Lemma no_level_closed_def : forall Θ Ξ Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns y Φ0 b pv r A oM,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns -> gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y (ge_def b pv r A oM)) ->
    r <> ak_level.
Proof. intros * H Hp; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Any other entry of it: what it denotes, read in the empty context, has no member of a type of levels.
Lemma no_level_closed_other : forall Θ Ξ Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns y Φ0 E,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns -> gm_prefix_upto Φ y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) ->
    (forall b pv r A oM, E <> ge_def b pv r A oM) ->
    exists R, edenote Θ Ξ ⋅ (Some (qname_in p y)) (ge_read T E) R /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ⁿˡ R.
Proof. intros * H Hp Hn; inversion H; subst; eexists; split; eauto. Qed.

A closed entry denotes the same description in every context; with no member of a type of levels in the empty context, it has none in any.
Lemma edenote_closed_no_level : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Γ' o E R R',
    entry_sc 0 E -> edenote Θ Ξ ⋅ o E R -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ⁿˡ R ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ o E R' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' -> R' = R /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ⁿˡ R.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * HE Hd HN Hd' HΓ'.
  pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) as Hc.
  assert (HS : slots_ok 0 (@nil centry)) by (intros ? ? Hx; inversion Hx).
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_scoped_all _ _ Hc))) _ _ _ _ Hd _ HS HE) as HsR.
  assert (Hσ : sub_mod_compat Id Γ nil) by (intros ? ? Hl; inversion Hl).
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_sub_all _ _ Hc))) _ _ _ _ Hd _ HS HE _ _ Hσ) as Hd1.
  rewrite (mdesc_closed_sub _ _ HsR) in Hd1.
  pose proof (edenote_closed_any _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE Hd1) as Hd2.
  split; [ exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg))) _ _ _ _ Hd' _ Hd2) |].
  rewrite <- (mdesc_closed_sub R Id HsR); exact (sub_preserves_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ HN (wf_sub_to_nil _ _ _ HΓ')).
Qed.

A module expression over a closed telescope denotes the same on top of any context, mentioning nothing of it.
Lemma mdenote_tele_weaken : forall Θ Ξ Δa Γ E E' R,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ -> mdenote Θ Ξ Δa E R ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ (Δa ++ Γ) E R /\ mdesc_scoped (length Δa) R.
Proof.
  intros * HE HΓ Hm.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE) as HΔ.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) as Hg.
  pose proof (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HΔ) as Hs.
  destruct (wf_modexp_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (_ & HsE & _).
  pose proof (proj1 (mdenote_scoped_all _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ Hm _ (slots_ok_ctx _ Hs) HsE) as HsR.
  pose proof (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΓ) as HΓ0.
  assert (Hw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ)) : ⋅).
  { apply wf_sub_of_wk; rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r Γ) at 1; apply wf_wk_shiftn_app;
      [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HΓ0 | constructor; exact Hg ]. }
  assert (Hσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δa) (ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ))) : Δa ++ ⋅).
  { pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ Δa _ _ _ Hw) as Hx; rewrite tele_sub_closed in Hx by exact Hs.
    apply Hx; [ exact HΓ | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HΔ ]. }
  rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hσ.
  pose proof (wf_sub_mdenote _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE Hm Hσ) as Hm'.
  assert (Hfix : forall x, x < length Δa -> sb_qn (length Δa) (ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ))) x = se_var x)
    by (intros x Hx; apply (sb_qn_fix _ _ 0); [ intros; lia | lia ]).
  rewrite (proj1 (proj2 syn_scoped_sub_id) _ _ _ HsE Hfix), (mdesc_sub_fix _ _ _ HsR Hfix) in Hm'.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

A description over a closed telescope with no member of a type of levels has none on top of any context.
Lemma no_level_tele_weaken : forall Θ Ξ Δa Γ R,
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ -> mdesc_scoped (length Δa) R ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ⊢ⁿˡ R -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R.
Proof.
  intros * HΔ HΓ HsR HN.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) as Hg.
  pose proof (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HΔ) as Hs.
  pose proof (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΓ) as HΓ0.
  assert (Hw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ)) : ⋅).
  { apply wf_sub_of_wk; rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r Γ) at 1; apply wf_wk_shiftn_app;
      [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HΓ0 | constructor; exact Hg ]. }
  assert (Hσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δa) (ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ))) : Δa ++ ⋅).
  { pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ Δa _ _ _ Hw) as Hx; rewrite tele_sub_closed in Hx by exact Hs.
    apply Hx; [ exact HΓ | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HΔ ]. }
  rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hσ.
  assert (Hfix : forall x, x < length Δa -> sb_qn (length Δa) (ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ))) x = se_var x)
    by (intros x Hx; apply (sb_qn_fix _ _ 0); [ intros; lia | lia ]).
  rewrite <- (mdesc_sub_fix _ _ _ HsR Hfix); exact (sub_preserves_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ HN Hσ).
Qed.

A type former with its closed module, with no member of a type of levels, read at arguments: it has none, anywhere.
Lemma no_level_former_read : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' A M pm Tm Φ Ns R0,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_dm nil A M (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φ nil) ->
    mdesc_ats_read (mdesc_dm nil A M (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φ nil)) Ns = Some R0 ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ⁿˡ R0.
Proof.
  intros * HN Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats.
  destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; cbn in Hats; try discriminate Hats.
  injection Hats as <-.
  inversion HN; subst; constructor; intros Rm' HRm; cbn in HRm; injection HRm as <-.
  eapply no_level_closed_any;
    match goal with Hm : forall Rm', mdesc_mod _ = Some Rm' -> _ |- _ => exact (Hm _ eq_refl) end.
Qed.

The module part of a description that can be abstracted can be.
Lemma desc_levels_abstractable_mod : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ R R',
    desc_levels_abstractable Θ Ξ Γ Δ R -> mdesc_mod R = Some R' -> desc_levels_abstractable Θ Ξ Γ Δ R'.
Proof. intros * [HL | HN] Hm; [ left; exact HL | right; exact (no_level_mod _ _ _ _ _ HN Hm) ]. Qed.

A stored alias's target, under its flag premise (levels_flag): what it denotes on top of any context can be abstracted over the alias's telescope there.
