Lemma levels_flag_abstractable : forall Θ Ξ Δa E lv Rt Γ0 Γ R,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E -> levels_flag Θ Ξ ⋅ Δa E lv Rt ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ0 -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ -> mdenote Θ Ξ (Δa ++ Γ0) E R ->
    desc_levels_abstractable Θ Ξ Γ Δa R.
Proof.
  intros * HE [Hsorted Hden Hnl] HΓ0 HΓ Hm.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE) as HΔ.
  pose proof (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HΔ) as Hs.
  destruct lv.
  - left; exact (Hsorted eq_refl).
  - right.
    pose proof (Hden eq_refl) as Hd; pose proof (Hnl eq_refl) as HN; rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hd, HN.
    destruct (mdenote_tele_weaken _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE HΓ0 Hd) as [Hd0 HsR].
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) as Hg.
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ Hd0).
    exact (no_level_tele_weaken _ _ _ _ _ HΔ HΓ HsR HN).
Qed.

The type former at typed arguments for its first uniform parameters.
Lemma wf_ind_args : forall Θ Ξ Γ p D k Mk Ns,
    decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> k < ind_ndecl D -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (ind_uparams D) Ns ->
    (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ind_ty_at D Mk Ns : Typeω@i) /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ apps (a_ind p k) Ns : ind_ty_at D Mk Ns.
Proof.
  intros * HD Hl Hk Hlt HΓ [T1 T2 HT Hlen Ha Hs HT2 HN].
  destruct (member_sort_typed _ _ _ _ _ HD Hk) as ([i Hi] & _).
  pose proof (member_params_wf _ _ _ _ _ HD Hk) as HP.
  assert (Hp : im_params D Mk = (im_nparams Mk ++ T1) ++ T2) by (unfold im_params; rewrite HT, List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
  rewrite Hp in Hi, HP.
  destruct (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ HP Hi) as [j HB].
  pose proof (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs HB HT2) as HB'.
  assert (Hat : ind_ty_at D Mk Ns = (ctx_pi (im_nparams Mk ++ T1) (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ)[sb_of_list Id Ns]).
  { unfold ind_ty_at; rewrite <- length_im_params, Hp.
    replace (length ((im_nparams Mk ++ T1) ++ T2) - length Ns) with (length (im_nparams Mk ++ T1))
      by (rewrite !List.length_app in *; lia).
    rewrite List.firstn_app, List.firstn_all, Nat.sub_diag; cbn [List.firstn]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity. }
  assert (HM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_ind p k : ctx_pi T2 (ctx_pi (im_nparams Mk ++ T1) (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ)).
  { rewrite <- ctx_pi_app, <- Hp; eapply wf_ind; eassumption. }
  pose proof (wf_sub_of_list_id _ _ _ _ _ Ha HT2 (eq_sym Hlen) HN) as Hσ.
  rewrite Hat; split.
  - exists j; pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB' Hσ) as H; cbn in H; exact H.
  - eapply wf_apps_ctx_pi; [ exact Ha | exact HT2 | exact HB' | exact HM | symmetry; exact Hlen | exact HN ].
Qed.

The type former of a typed record at arguments for its outermost parameters is of the type its declaration gives there.
Lemma wf_record_args : forall Θ Ξ Γ p R Ns,
    record_typed Θ Ξ R -> record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (record_params R) Ns ->
    (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ record_ty_at R Ns : Typeω@i) /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ apps (a_record p) Ns : record_ty_at R Ns.
Proof.
  intros * HR Hl HΓ [T1 T2 HT Hlen Ha Hs HT2 HN].
  pose proof HR as [_ _ HSu _ _].
  destruct (wf_is_univ_typ HSu) as [i Hi].
  pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx HSu) as HP.
  rewrite HT in Hi, HP.
  destruct (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ HP Hi) as [j HB].
  pose proof (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs HB HT2) as HB'.
  assert (Hat : record_ty_at R Ns = (ctx_pi T1 (record_sort R))[sb_of_list Id Ns]).
  { unfold record_ty_at; rewrite HT.
    replace (length (T1 ++ T2) - length Ns) with (length T1) by (rewrite List.length_app; lia).
    rewrite List.firstn_app, List.firstn_all, Nat.sub_diag; cbn [List.firstn]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity. }
  assert (HM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_record p : ctx_pi T2 (ctx_pi T1 (record_sort R))).
  { rewrite <- ctx_pi_app, <- HT; exact (record_typed_former _ _ _ _ _ HR Hl HΓ). }
  pose proof (wf_sub_of_list_id _ _ _ _ _ Ha HT2 (eq_sym Hlen) HN) as Hσ.
  rewrite Hat; split.
  - exists j; pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB' Hσ) as H; cbn in H; exact H.
  - eapply wf_apps_ctx_pi; [ exact Ha | exact HT2 | exact HB' | exact HM | symmetry; exact Hlen | exact HN ].
Qed.

No argument is an argument list for any telescope.
Lemma args_ok_nil : forall Θ Ξ Γ T, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> args_ok Θ Ξ Γ T nil.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ; exists T nil; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity | reflexivity | constructor | exact I | exact HΓ |].
  intros k ? ? Hk; rewrite List.nth_error_nil in Hk; discriminate.
Qed.

The type former of a member of a typed group, at arguments for its outermost uniform parameters, with its module there: typed.
Lemma desc_ok_ind_former_at : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> forall Γ pq k D Mk Ns pm Tm Φm,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ pq = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> k < ind_ndecl D -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (ind_uparams D) Ns -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm Ns) ->
    exists R', mdesc_ats_read (ind_former_desc pq k D Mk (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm nil)) Ns = Some R' /\ desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R'.
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hv * Hl HMk Hlt HΓ Hargs Hok.
  pose proof Hv as [HΘv HΞv].
  pose proof (ind_lookup_valid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘv HΞv Hl) as HD.
  pose proof (decl_closed_ass _ (gctx_closed_ind _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) Hl)) as HaU.
  unfold ind_former_desc; cbn [mdesc_ats_read].
  rewrite (mdesc_term_part_ats_ind _ _ _ _ _ HaU (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)), mdesc_ats_closed_nil; cbn [List.app].
  eexists; split; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (wf_ind_args _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hl HMk Hlt HΓ Hargs) as [[i Hi] HM].
  rewrite <- (mdesc_up_nil (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm Ns)).
  eapply desc_ok_dm with (param_level := 0);
    [ exact HΓ | constructor | exact Hi | exact HM | exact Hok | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ].
Qed.

The type former of a typed record type at arguments for its outermost parameters, with its module there: typed.
Lemma desc_ok_record_former_at : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> forall Γ p R Ns pm Tm Φm,
    record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (record_params R) Ns -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm Ns) ->
    exists R', mdesc_ats_read (record_former_desc p R (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm nil)) Ns = Some R' /\ desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R'.
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hv * Hl HΓ Hargs Hok.
  pose proof (record_lookup_typed _ _ Hg Hv _ _ Hl) as HRt.
  unfold record_former_desc; cbn [mdesc_ats_read].
  rewrite (mdesc_term_part_ats_record _ _ _ (typed_params_ass _ _ _ HRt) (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)), mdesc_ats_closed_nil;
    cbn [List.app].
  eexists; split; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (wf_record_args _ _ _ _ _ _ HRt Hl HΓ Hargs) as [[i Hi] HM].
  rewrite <- (mdesc_up_nil (mdesc_closed nil pm Tm Φm Ns)).
  eapply desc_ok_dm with (param_level := 0);
    [ exact HΓ | constructor | exact Hi | exact HM | exact Hok | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ].
Qed.

closed_entry_read Θ Ξ Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns M R R' R0: the entry R of the closed module at p, read at the arguments Ns under the outside parameters Θ' as the name M, is R', from the description R0 at the arguments.
Record closed_entry_read (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Θ' : ctx) (p : qname) (T : ctx) (Φ : gmod) (Ns : list exp)
  (M : exp) (R R' R0 : mdesc) : Prop := mk_closed_entry_read
  {
The entry read: R0 named, abstracted over Θ'
    closed_entry_read_result : R' = mdesc_up Θ' (mdesc_named Θ' Ns M R0)
    
R0 is R at the arguments
  ; closed_entry_read_args : mdesc_ats_read R Ns = Some R0
    
Named, it is typed under the outside parameters
  ; closed_entry_read_typed : desc_ok Θ Ξ (Θ' ++ Γ) (mdesc_named Θ' Ns M R0)
    
It has no member of a type of levels where the module has none
  ; closed_entry_read_no_level : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_named Θ' Ns M R0
    
It is no module still being defined: what is filed reads no open frame
  ; closed_entry_read_frame_free : ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ (mdesc_named Θ' Ns M R0) }.

An entry of a typed closed description, read with the arguments recorded, under the outside parameters: typed, and with no member of a type of levels where the module has none.
Lemma desc_ok_entry_closed_read : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
    forall Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns y Γy E rd R R',
    desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) -> mdesc_entry (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) y = Some (Γy, E, rd) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ (Γy ++ Γ) (Some (qname_in p y)) E R -> mdesc_read rd R = Some R' ->
    exists R0, closed_entry_read Θ Ξ Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) R R' R0.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg Hv * HR He Hed Hr.
  inversion HR as [| | Γ0 Θa T0 Φ1 Ns0 Θ0 Ξ0 p0 lΘ Hg0 Hsub Hloc Ha HsT HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ' HRΘ' HLΘ' |]; subst.
  destruct (mdesc_entry_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (loc_closed _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc) He) as (_ & HsEntry & _).
  cbn in He; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [[| Φ0 x E0 | ? ? ?] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
  injection He as <- <- <-.
  destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & [= <- -> <-] & Hent).
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hr; destruct (mdesc_ats_read R Ns) as [R0 |] eqn:Hats; [| discriminate ]; injection Hr as <-.
  (* the entry as it is stored now, grown, is valid *)
  assert (Hloc' : exists Φ', loc Θ Ξ p T Φ').
  { destruct Hloc as [Hf | Hb].
    - destruct (gc_sub_frame_loc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsub Hf) as (Φ' & [[Hf' _] | [Hb' _]]); exists Φ'; [ left | right ]; assumption.
    - destruct (gc_sub_body _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsub Hb) as (Φ' & Hb' & _); exists Φ'; right; exact Hb'. }
  destruct Hloc' as (Φ' & Hloc').
  pose proof (proj2 (loc_entry _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc _ _) Hent) as HeΘ0.
  destruct (gc_sub_entry _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsub HeΘ0) as (E1 & HeΘ & Hgr).
  pose proof (proj1 (loc_entry _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hloc' _ _) HeΘ) as Hent1.
  destruct (gm_entry_prefix _ _ _ (body_closed_noopen _ _ (proj2 (loc_closed _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hloc'))) Hent1) as (Φ0' & Hp1).
  destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ Hv Hloc') as [_ HvΦ].
  pose proof (gm_valid_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HvΦ Hp1) as HE0.
  pose proof (gm_coherent_prefix _ _ _ _ _ (loc_coherent _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc) Hp) as HcE0.
  pose proof (loc_closed _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc) as [_ HcΦ].
  pose proof (body_closed_prefix _ _ _ _ HcΦ Hp) as HcE; cbn in HcE; destruct HcE as [_ HcE].
  pose proof (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsT HT HΘ') as HTΘ.
  exists R0.
  enough (Hparts : ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ R /\
                   (desc_ok Θ Ξ (Θ' ++ Γ) (mdesc_named Θ' Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) R0) /\
                    (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns ->
                     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_named Θ' Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) R0)))
    by (destruct Hparts as (HFr & HP1 & HP2); constructor; first [ reflexivity | exact Hats | assumption
         | intros Hr; apply HFr; exact (desc_reads_frame_ats_read _ _ _ _ Hats (proj1 (desc_reads_frame_named _ _ _ _ _) Hr)) ]).
  (* an entry other than a definition, where the module has no member of
     a type of levels, denotes a description with none *)
  assert (HNo : (forall b pv r A oM, E0 <> ge_def b pv r A oM) ->
                Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R).
  { intros Hnd HNl.
    destruct (no_level_closed_other _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HNl Hp Hnd) as (Rn & Hdn & HNn).
    destruct (edenote_closed_no_level _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ HsEntry Hdn HNn Hed HΘ') as [-> HNR]; exact HNR. }
  destruct E0 as [b pv r A oM | pv [Δ [sm Φy | E'] ] | pv pq k D ΦD | pv Adm Mdm Udm | pv pr Rr ΦR ].
  - (* a definition: its body, applied *)
    cbn in Hgr; subst E1.
    cbn in HE0; destruct HE0 as (A0 & -> & [iA HLsrt HA0] & HM0).
    inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    assert (Hom : exists om0, (if b then oM else None) = option_map (ctx_fn T) om0 /\ forall M0, om0 = Some M0 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ M0 : A0).
    { destruct b; [| exists None; split; [ reflexivity | discriminate ] ].
      destruct oM as [M |]; [| exists None; split; [ reflexivity | discriminate ] ].
      destruct (HM0 M eq_refl) as (M0 & -> & HM); exists (Some M0); split; [ reflexivity | intros ? [= <-]; exact HM ]. }
    destruct Hom as (om0 & Hom & Hom0).
    rewrite Hom in Hats; change (mdesc_term r (ctx_pi_at r T A0) (option_map (ctx_fn T) om0)) with (mdesc_up T (mdesc_term r A0 om0)) in Hats.
    (* a definition is no module *)
    split; [ intros (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & Hm & _); cbn in Hm; discriminate |].
    (* where the module has no member of a type of levels, the type is of
       a large universe *)
    split.
    2:{ intros HNl; apply no_level_named.
        pose proof (no_level_closed_def _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HNl Hp) as Hr1.
        eapply no_level_ats_up; [ exact HTΘ | exact Ha | exact (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) | exact (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)
                                | apply wf_no_level_term; exact Hr1
                                | exact Hats ]. }
    pose proof (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HA0 HTΘ) as HA0Θ.
    assert (HLA : forall om, desc_levels_abstractable Θ Ξ (Θ' ++ Γ) T (mdesc_term r A0 om))
      by (intros; eapply closed_term_levels_abstractable; [ exact HsT | exact HTΘ | exact HLsrt | exact HA0 ]).
    destruct om0 as [M0 |].
    + (* transparent: its body *)
      destruct (ats_up_ok _ _ Hg Ns (Θ' ++ Γ) T (mdesc_term r A0 (Some M0)) 0 HTΘ Ha (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)) as (R1 & HR1 & Hok1).
      { eapply desc_ok_term; [ exact HA0Θ | intros M1 HM; exact (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT (Hom0 _ HM) HTΘ) ]. }
      { exact (HLA _). }
      rewrite Hats in HR1; injection HR1 as <-.
      destruct (mdesc_ats_some_red _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (A' & M' & ->); apply mdesc_named_cases; exact Hok1.
    + (* an axiom or abstract: its name, at the arguments *)
      destruct (proj1 (ctx_pi_type_kind _ _ r T (Θ' ++ Γ) A0 iA HTΘ (fun _ => Ha) HLsrt HA0Θ)) as [j Hj].
      pose proof (filed_def_wf _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘ' Hloc' Hp1 Hom
                    (type_sort_abs_kind r _ (type_sort_universe j)) Hj) as Hname.
      destruct (ats_up_self_ok _ _ Hg Ns (Θ' ++ Γ) T r A0 _ HTΘ Ha (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)
                  (ex_intro _ iA HA0Θ) (HLA _) Hname) as (R1 & HR1 & Hok1).
      rewrite Hats in HR1; injection HR1 as <-.
      (* read bare, it is the term of no δ-reduct itself *)
      apply mdesc_named_cases; [| exact Hok1 ].
      destruct (ats_up_ok _ _ Hg Ns (Θ' ++ Γ) T (mdesc_term r A0 None) 0 HTΘ Ha (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)) as (R2 & HR2 & Hok2).
      { eapply desc_ok_term; [ exact HA0Θ | intros ? [=] ]. }
      { exact (HLA _). }
      rewrite Hats in HR2; injection HR2 as <-; exact Hok2.
  - (* a closed submodule: its body, at the arguments recorded *)
    destruct HcE as (-> & HsΔ & HcΦy).
    destruct E1 as [| pv1 [Δ1 [sm1 Φy1 | ?]] | | | ]; cbn in Hgr; try discriminate; destruct Hgr as (<- & <- & <-).
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    match goal with Hx : body_xp _ _ _ Φy ?Φx |- _ =>
      pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hx _ (body_xp_noopen Θ Ξ _ _ (body_closed_noopen _ _ HcΦy))) as <- end.
    match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
    cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-; cbn [List.app].
    destruct HE0 as [[HaΔT HΔT] _].
    destruct (loc_child_mod _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc _ _ _ _ _ Hent) as [Hb _].
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix by reflexivity.
    (* the submodule is filed below, no open frame *)
    split; [ intros (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & Hm & Hf); cbn in Hm; injection Hm as _ <- _ _ _;
             destruct (gc_sub_body _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsub Hb) as (? & Hb' & _); exact (Hf (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb')) |].
    split; [| intros HNl; eapply no_level_closed_any; exact (HNo ltac:(intros; discriminate) HNl) ].
    eapply desc_ok_closed with (param_level := 0);
      [ exact Hg0 | exact Hsub | right; exact Hb | exact HaΔT
      | exact (proj1 (gctx_closed_body _ _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg0) Hb)) | exact HΔT | exact HΘ'
      | apply args_ok_ext; exact Hargs | constructor | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ].
  - (* an alias: the module part of what its target denotes, at the
       arguments for the telescope it is stored over *)
    cbn in Hgr; subst E1.
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    cbn [List.app] in *.
    cbn [syn_V] in HE0; destruct HE0 as [HEw [HΔ [[lΔ HRΔ] [(lv & Rt & Hlv) Hcl]]]].
    rewrite gunit_scoped_mk in HcE; destruct HcE as [HsΔ HsE]; cbn [moddef_scoped] in HsE; rewrite Nat.add_0_r in HsE.
    destruct HcE0 as (Δ0 & -> & HaΔ0).
    pose proof (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΘ') as HΓ.
    pose proof (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsΔ HΔ HΓ) as HΔΓ.
    pose proof (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsΔ HΔ (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HTΘ)) as HΔΘ.
    match goal with Hm : mdenote _ _ _ E' ?R1, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?R1 = Some ?R1m |- _ =>
      destruct (proj2 (Hcl _ HΔΓ) _ Hm) as (Hok1 & _ & HFr1);
      assert (HFr1m : ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ R1m) by (intros Hr; exact (HFr1 (desc_reads_frame_mod _ _ _ Hmd Hr)));
      pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hok1 Hmd) as Hok1m;
      pose proof (proj1 (mdenote_scoped_all _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ Hm _
                    (slots_ok_app _ 0 _ ltac:(intros ? ? ?; lia) ltac:(exact HsΔ)) ltac:(rewrite Nat.add_0_r; exact HsE)) as HsR1;
      rewrite Nat.add_0_r in HsR1;
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_scoped _ _ _ HsR1 Hmd) as HsR1m;
      (* the target's module part can be abstracted over the telescope *)
      pose proof (desc_levels_abstractable_mod _ _ _ _ _ _
                    (levels_flag_abstractable _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Θ' ++ Γ) _ HEw Hlv HΔΓ HΔΘ Hm) Hmd) as HLR1m end.
    pose proof (desc_ok_tele_weaken _ _ Hg _ Θ' _ _ HsΔ HΔΓ HΔΘ HsR1m Hok1m) as Hok2.
    assert (HaΔ : all_assumptions (Δ0 ++ T)) by (apply List.Forall_app; split; assumption).
    pose proof (args_ok_ext _ _ _ _ _ Δ0 Hargs) as Hargs'.
    destruct (ats_up_ok _ _ Hg Ns (Θ' ++ Γ) (Δ0 ++ T) _ lΔ HΔΘ HaΔ (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs') (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs') Hok2
                (up_evaluated_of _ _ _ _ _ _ (params_evaluated_closed _ _ _ _ _ HsΔ HRΔ HΔΘ) HLR1m (fun _ => HFr1m))) as (R2 & HR2 & Hok3).
    rewrite mdesc_ats_read_mod in Hats by (apply mdesc_is_mod_up; eapply mdesc_mod_is_mod; eassumption).
    rewrite Hats in HR2; injection HR2 as <-.
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix.
    2:{ apply mdesc_self_mod.
        eapply mdesc_ats_is_mod; [| exact Hats ]; apply mdesc_is_mod_up; eapply mdesc_mod_is_mod; eassumption. }
    split; [ intros Hr; exact (HFr1m (proj1 (desc_reads_frame_up _ _ _) Hr)) |].
    split; [ exact Hok3 |].
    (* where the module has no member of a type of levels, nor has the
       target's module part *)
    intros HNl; pose proof (HNo ltac:(intros; discriminate) HNl) as HNR.
    eapply no_level_ats_up; [ exact HΔΘ | exact HaΔ | exact (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs') | exact (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs')
                            | | exact Hats ].
    exact (proj1 (no_level_up_mod _ _ (Θ' ++ Γ) (Δ0 ++ T) _ ltac:(eapply mdesc_mod_is_mod; eassumption)) HNR).
  - (* an inductive type, stored at its own path: its type former at the
       arguments, with its module there *)
    destruct E1 as [| | pv1 pq1 k1 D1 ΦD1 | |]; cbn in Hgr; try discriminate; destruct Hgr as (<- & <- & <- & <-).
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Mk pm Tm Φm HMk Hpm Hlm | |]; subst.
    destruct HE0 as (_ & [HaU HU] & _).
    destruct HcE0 as ((Δ0 & HΔ0 & _) & _).
    destruct (gc_entry_ind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HeΘ) as [_ Hml].
    destruct (ind_mlookup_selfpath _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hml) as [Hmp _ Hlt].
    pose proof (ind_mlookup_group _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hml) as Hl.
    pose proof (decl_closed_uparams _ (gctx_closed_ind _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) Hl)) as HsU.
    (* the module, stored at the type's path over the uniform parameters *)
    pose proof (loc_child_ind _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc' Hent1) as Hbm.
    rewrite Hmp in Hpm; injection Hpm as <-.
    rewrite (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ (or_intror Hbm)) in Hlm; injection Hlm as <- <-.
    assert (HargsU : args_ok Θ Ξ (Θ' ++ Γ) (ind_uparams D) Ns) by (rewrite HΔ0; apply args_ok_ext; exact Hargs).
    destruct (desc_ok_ind_former_at _ _ Hg Hv _ _ _ _ _ _ (qname_in p y) (ind_uparams D) ΦD1 Hl HMk Hlt HΘ' HargsU)
      as (R1 & HR1 & Hok1).
    { eapply desc_ok_closed with (param_level := 0);
        [ exact Hg | apply gc_sub_refl | right; exact Hbm | exact HaU | exact HsU | exact HU | exact HΘ'
        | exact HargsU | constructor | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ]. }
    rewrite Hats in HR1; injection HR1 as <-.
    (* the module is filed at the type's path, no open frame *)
    split; [ intros (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & Hm & Hf); unfold ind_former_desc in Hm; cbn in Hm; injection Hm as _ <- _ _ _;
             exact (Hf (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hbm)) |].
    split; [| intros HNl; apply no_level_named; exact (no_level_former_read _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HNo ltac:(intros; discriminate) HNl) Hats) ].
    unfold ind_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; mdesc_dm_read_shape Hats.
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix by reflexivity; exact Hok1.
  - (* a definition with a module part: its term part at the arguments,
       as a transparent definition's, and its module part at them *)
    cbn in Hgr; subst E1.
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    cbn [List.app] in *.
    cbn [ge_valid syn_V] in HE0.
    destruct HE0 as ([HEw [HΔ [[lΔ HRΔ] [(lv & Rt & Hlv) Hcl]]]] & (A0 & -> & _ & HM0) & (A1 & i & HA1 & HA0)).
    (* its term part's type is of a universe (wf_gentry_def_mod) *)
    pose proof (ctx_pi_at_ass_injective _ _ _ _ Ha HA1) as <-.
    destruct (HM0 _ eq_refl) as (M0 & -> & HM0').
    destruct HcE0 as (_ & Δ0 & E0' & HΔ0 & HaΔ0); injection HΔ0 as HΔ0 HE0'; subst.
    destruct HcE as (HsA & HsM & HsU).
    rewrite gunit_scoped_mk in HsU; destruct HsU as [HsΔ HsE]; cbn [moddef_scoped] in HsE; rewrite Nat.add_0_r in HsE.
    (* the module part, as an alias's *)
    pose proof (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΘ') as HΓ.
    pose proof (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsΔ HΔ HΓ) as HΔΓ.
    pose proof (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsΔ HΔ (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HTΘ)) as HΔΘ.
    match goal with Hm : mdenote _ _ _ ?E' ?R1, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?R1 = Some ?R1m |- _ =>
      destruct (proj2 (Hcl _ HΔΓ) _ Hm) as (Hok1 & _ & HFr1);
      assert (HFr1m : ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ R1m) by (intros Hr; exact (HFr1 (desc_reads_frame_mod _ _ _ Hmd Hr)));
      pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hok1 Hmd) as Hok1m;
      pose proof (proj1 (mdenote_scoped_all _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ Hm _
                    (slots_ok_app _ 0 _ ltac:(intros ? ? ?; lia) ltac:(exact HsΔ)) ltac:(rewrite Nat.add_0_r; exact HsE)) as HsR1;
      rewrite Nat.add_0_r in HsR1;
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_scoped _ _ _ HsR1 Hmd) as HsR1m;
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd) as HmR1m;
      (* the target's module part can be abstracted over the telescope *)
      pose proof (desc_levels_abstractable_mod _ _ _ _ _ _
                    (levels_flag_abstractable _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Θ' ++ Γ) _ HEw Hlv HΔΓ HΔΘ Hm) Hmd) as HLR1m end.
    pose proof (desc_ok_tele_weaken _ _ Hg _ Θ' _ _ HsΔ HΔΓ HΔΘ HsR1m Hok1m) as Hok2.
    assert (HaΔ : all_assumptions (Δ0 ++ T)) by (apply List.Forall_app; split; assumption).
    pose proof (args_ok_ext _ _ _ _ _ Δ0 Hargs) as Hargs'.
    destruct (ats_up_ok _ _ Hg Ns (Θ' ++ Γ) (Δ0 ++ T) _ lΔ HΔΘ HaΔ (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs') (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs') Hok2
                (up_evaluated_of _ _ _ _ _ _ (params_evaluated_closed _ _ _ _ _ HsΔ HRΔ HΔΘ) HLR1m (fun _ => HFr1m))) as (R2 & HR2 & Hok3).
    (* the term part: as a transparent definition, at the arguments *)
    pose proof (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HA0 HTΘ) as HA0Θ.
    destruct (ats_up_ok _ _ Hg Ns (Θ' ++ Γ) T (mdesc_term ak_relevant A0 (Some M0)) 0 HTΘ Ha (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)
                (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)) as (R3 & HR3 & Hok4).
    { eapply (desc_ok_term _ _ _ ak_relevant); [ exact HA0Θ
                           | intros M1 [= <-]; exact (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HM0' HTΘ) ]. }
    { eapply (closed_term_levels_abstractable _ _ _ _ ak_relevant); [ exact HsT | exact HTΘ | discriminate | exact HA0 ]. }
    cbn [mdesc_up option_map] in HR3.
    destruct (mdesc_ats_some_red _ _ _ _ _ HR3) as (B & M' & ->).
    cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; rewrite (mdesc_term_part_ats_of_ats _ _ _ HR3), HR2 in Hats; cbv beta iota in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix by reflexivity.
    pose proof (mdesc_ats_is_mod _ _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ HmR1m) HR2) as HmR2.
    split; [ intros Hr; exact (HFr1m (proj1 (desc_reads_frame_up _ _ _) (proj1 (desc_reads_frame_dm _ _ _ _ _) Hr))) |].
    split.
    2:{ (* where the module has no member of a type of levels, nor has
           the target's module part *)
        intros HNl; pose proof (HNo ltac:(intros; discriminate) HNl) as HNR.
        constructor; intros Rm' HRm.
        destruct R2; cbn in HmR2, HRm; try contradiction; injection HRm as <-.
        all: eapply no_level_ats_up; [ exact HΔΘ | exact HaΔ | exact (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs')
                                     | exact (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs') | | exact HR2 ].
        all: inversion HNR; subst.
        all: match goal with Hm : forall Rm', mdesc_mod _ = Some Rm' -> _ |- _ =>
               apply (proj1 (no_level_up_mod _ _ (Θ' ++ Γ) (Δ0 ++ T) _ HmR1m)); apply Hm;
               rewrite mdesc_mod_up, (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ HmR1m); reflexivity end. }
    inversion Hok4 as [? ? ? ? ? HBt HMB | | |]; subst.
    rewrite <- (mdesc_up_nil R2).
    eapply desc_ok_dm with (Θd := nil) (param_level := 0);
      [ exact HΘ' | constructor | exact HBt | exact (HMB _ eq_refl) | exact Hok3 | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ].
  - (* a record type, stored at its own path: its type former at the
       arguments, with its module there *)
    destruct E1 as [| ? [? [? ?| ?]] | | | pv1 pr1 Rr1 ΦR1]; cbn in Hgr; try discriminate; try contradiction.
    destruct Hgr as (<- & <- & <-).
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed as [| | | | ? ? ? ? ? ? Tm Φm Hlm]; subst.
    pose proof (gc_entry_record_selfpath _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ HeΘ) as ->.
    destruct HE0 as (_ & [HaU HU] & _).
    destruct HcE0 as ((Δ0 & HΔ0 & _) & _).
    destruct HcE as ((HF & _) & _).
    assert (Hrl : record_lookup Θ Ξ (qname_in p y) = Some Rr)
      by (unfold record_lookup; rewrite (gc_entry_record_frame_none _ _ _ _ HeΘ), HeΘ; reflexivity).
    (* the module, stored at the type's path over its module telescope *)
    pose proof (loc_child_record _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc' Hent1) as Hbm.
    rewrite (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ (or_intror Hbm)) in Hlm; injection Hlm as <- <-.
    assert (HargsP : args_ok Θ Ξ (Θ' ++ Γ) (record_params Rr) Ns) by (rewrite HΔ0; apply args_ok_ext; exact Hargs).
    destruct (desc_ok_record_former_at _ _ Hg Hv _ _ _ _ (qname_in p y) (record_mod_tele (qname_in p y) Rr) ΦR1 Hrl HΘ' HargsP)
      as (R1 & HR1 & Hok1).
    { eapply desc_ok_closed with (param_level := 0);
        [ exact Hg | apply gc_sub_refl | right; exact Hbm | exact HaU
        | exact (record_mod_tele_scoped _ _ (proj2 (proj1 (ctx_scoped_app_iff _ _) HF)))
        | exact HU | exact HΘ' | | constructor | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ].
      unfold record_mod_tele; rewrite HΔ0.
      exact (args_ok_ext _ _ _ _ _ (ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort Rr)) (record_self (qname_in p y) Rr) :: Δ0) Hargs). }
    rewrite Hats in HR1; injection HR1 as <-.
    (* the module is filed at the type's path, no open frame *)
    split; [ intros (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & Hm & Hf); unfold record_former_desc in Hm; cbn in Hm; injection Hm as _ <- _ _ _;
             exact (Hf (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hbm)) |].
    split; [| intros HNl; apply no_level_named; exact (no_level_former_read _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HNo ltac:(intros; discriminate) HNl) Hats) ].
    unfold record_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; mdesc_dm_read_shape Hats.
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix by reflexivity; exact Hok1.
Qed.

An entry of a typed closed description, read with the arguments recorded and abstracted over the outside parameters, is typed: it can be abstracted over them, as the module can (desc_ok_closed).
Lemma desc_ok_entry_closed : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
    forall Γ Θ' p T Φ Ns y Γy E rd R R',
    desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) -> mdesc_entry (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) y = Some (Γy, E, rd) ->
    edenote Θ Ξ (Γy ++ Γ) (Some (qname_in p y)) E R -> mdesc_read rd R = Some R' -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R'.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg Hv * HR He Hed Hr.
  destruct (desc_ok_entry_closed_read _ _ Hg Hv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR He Hed Hr) as (R0 & [-> _ Hok HN HFr]).
  inversion HR as [| | Γ0 Θa T0 Φ1 Ns0 Θ0 Ξ0 p0 lΘ Hg0 Hsub Hloc Ha HsT HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ' HRΘ' HLΘ' |]; subst.
  apply (desc_ok_up _ _ _ _ _ lΘ); [ exact Hok | exact HΘ' | exact HaΘ' | apply up_evaluated_of; [ exact HRΘ' | | exact (fun _ => HFr) ] ].
  destruct HLΘ' as [HL | HL]; [ left; exact HL | right; exact (HN HL) ].
Qed.

Well-formed Module Expressions Denote Typed Descriptions

The unit of each slot of Γ (of a module or of a definition with a module part) denotes, where it stands, only typed descriptions.
Definition slots_typed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : Prop :=
  forall Γ1 e U Γ0, Γ = Γ1 ++ e :: Γ0 -> centry_unit e = Some U ->
    forall R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ0 None U R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ0 R.

Lemma slots_typed_nil : forall Θ Ξ, slots_typed Θ Ξ nil.
Proof. intros * Γ1 e U Γ0 Heq; destruct Γ1; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma slots_typed_cons : forall Θ Ξ Γ e, slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ ->
    (forall U, centry_unit e = Some U -> forall R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R) -> slots_typed Θ Ξ (e :: Γ).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ He Γ1 e0 U Γ0 Heq Hu R HR.
  destruct Γ1 as [| e' Γ1]; cbn in Heq; injection Heq as Heq1 Heq2; subst.
  - exact (He _ Hu _ HR).
  - exact (HΓ _ _ _ _ eq_refl Hu _ HR).
Qed.

Lemma slots_typed_app : forall Θ Ξ Ψ Γ, slots_typed Θ Ξ (Ψ ++ Γ) -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Γ1 e U Γ0 -> Hu R HR; apply (HΓ (Ψ ++ Γ1) e U Γ0); [ rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | exact Hu | exact HR ].
Qed.

A description of a unit, weakened past one entry.
Lemma desc_ok_shift : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ e U R0, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ e :: Γ -> gunit_scoped (length Γ) U ->
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R0 -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R0 ->
    forall R, udenote Θ Ξ (e :: Γ) None (gunit_wk U ↑) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ (e :: Γ) R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * He HU HR0 Hok R HR.
  rewrite (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ _ HR _ (udenote_shift _ _ _ _ _ _ He HU HR0)).
  eapply desc_ok_sub; [ exact Hg | exact Hok | apply wf_sub_of_wk, wf_wk_shift; exact He ].
Qed.

Lemma slots_typed_lookup : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ x U, Γ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ ->
    forall R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg; induction 1 as [U Γ | U A M Γ | Γ n U e Hl IH]; intros HΓ Hs.
  - destruct (ctx_decomp_mod HΓ) as [HΓ0 HU].
    destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & [R0 HR0] & _).
    destruct (wf_unit_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & HUs & _).
    eapply desc_ok_shift; [ exact Hg | exact HΓ | exact HUs | exact HR0 | exact (Hs nil _ U Γ eq_refl eq_refl _ HR0) ].
  - destruct (ctx_decomp_dm HΓ) as (HΓ0 & _ & _ & HU).
    destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & [R0 HR0] & _).
    destruct (wf_unit_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & HUs & _).
    eapply desc_ok_shift; [ exact Hg | exact HΓ | exact HUs | exact HR0 | exact (Hs nil _ U Γ eq_refl eq_refl _ HR0) ].
  - pose proof (ctx_decomp_tail HΓ) as HΓ0.
    destruct (proj1 denote_exists _ _ _ HΓ0 _ _ Hl) as [R0 HR0].
    pose proof (ctx_scoped_lookup_mod _ _ _ 0 (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HΓ0) Hl) as HUs; rewrite Nat.add_0_r in HUs.
    eapply desc_ok_shift; [ exact Hg | exact HΓ | exact HUs | exact HR0 |].
    exact (IH HΓ0 (slots_typed_app _ _ (e :: nil) _ Hs) _ HR0).
Qed.

A stored location, at no argument.
Lemma desc_ok_loc : forall Θ Ξ Γ p T Φ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> loc Θ Ξ p T Φ ->
    desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ nil).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hv Hl.
  destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ Hv Hl) as [[Ha HT _ _] _].
  eapply desc_ok_closed with (param_level := 0);
    [ exact (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) | apply gc_sub_refl | exact Hl | exact Ha | exact (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HT) | exact HT | exact HΓ
    | | constructor | apply params_evaluated_nil | apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) ].
  exists T nil; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity | reflexivity | constructor | constructor | exact HΓ |].
  intros k ? ? Hk; rewrite List.nth_error_nil in Hk; discriminate.
Qed.

A loaded unit or an open frame, at no argument.
Lemma desc_ok_unit : forall Θ Ξ Γ H p T Φ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> mod_qname H = Some p ->
    gc_unit Θ Ξ H = Some (T, Φ) -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ nil).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hv Hq Hu.
  destruct (gc_unit_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hu) as (mp & Hq' & Hl); rewrite Hq in Hq'; injection Hq' as <-.
  exact (desc_ok_loc _ _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hv Hl).
Qed.

A member of a module of typed descriptions.
Lemma desc_ok_mem : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> forall Γ H y R,
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> (forall R0, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R0 -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R0) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H y) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hv * HΓ HH Hm; inversion Hm; subst.
  - eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption.
  - (* the open frame of a member's module: the member's type former, with
       its module *)
    match goal with Hk0 : gs_find_ind _ _ = Some _ |- _ => rename Hk0 into Hk end.
    match goal with Hm0 : ind_member _ _ = Some _ |- _ => rename Hm0 into HMk end.
    match goal with Hl0 : gc_loc _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => rename Hl0 into Hlm end.
    destruct (frame_ind_selfpath _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hk) as [_ _ Hlt].
    pose proof (frame_ind_lookup _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hk) as Hl.
    destruct (desc_ok_ind_former_at _ _ Hg Hv Γ _ _ _ _ nil _ _ _ Hl HMk Hlt HΓ (args_ok_nil _ _ _ _ HΓ)
                (desc_ok_loc _ _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hv (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hlm))) as (R1 & HR1 & Hok1).
    rewrite mdesc_ats_read_nil in HR1; injection HR1 as <-; exact Hok1.
  - match goal with Hm0 : mdenote _ _ _ H ?R0, Hd : mdesc_mod ?R0 = Some ?Rm, He : mdesc_entry ?Rm _ = Some _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (HH _ Hm0) Hd) as Hok;
      destruct Rm; cbn in He; try discriminate
    end.
    + eapply desc_ok_entry_open; eassumption.
    + eapply desc_ok_entry_closed; eassumption.
  - (* the open frame of a record's module: the record's type former, with
       its module *)
    match goal with Hk0 : gs_find_record _ _ = Some _ |- _ => rename Hk0 into Hk end.
    match goal with Hl0 : gc_loc _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => rename Hl0 into Hlm end.
    assert (Hrl : record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R0) by (unfold record_lookup; rewrite Hk; reflexivity).
    destruct (desc_ok_record_former_at _ _ Hg Hv Γ _ _ nil _ _ _ Hrl HΓ (args_ok_nil _ _ _ _ HΓ)
                (desc_ok_loc _ _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hv (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hlm))) as (R1 & HR1 & Hok1).
    rewrite mdesc_ats_read_nil in HR1; injection HR1 as <-; exact Hok1.
Qed.

Lemma body_shape_names : forall Φ Φ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> gm_names Φ = gm_names Φ'.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros [| Φ' x' E' | Φ' H' its' Φg'] Hs; cbn in Hs |- *; try contradiction; [ reflexivity | |].
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & <- & _); f_equal; apply IH; exact Hs.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & <- & _); f_equal; apply IH; exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma body_shape_l : forall Φ Φ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape Φ Φ.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros [| Φ' x' E' | Φ' H' its' Φg'] Hs; cbn in Hs |- *; try contradiction; [ exact I | |].
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & HE); split; [ exact (IH _ Hs) | split; [ reflexivity |] ].
    destruct E as [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ], E' as [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ]; cbn in HE |- *; try contradiction; destruct_all; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & Hg); split; [ exact (IH _ Hs) | split; [ reflexivity | exact (IHg _ Hg) ] ].
Qed.

Lemma body_shape_r : forall Φ Φ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape Φ' Φ'.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros [| Φ' x' E' | Φ' H' its' Φg'] Hs; cbn in Hs |- *; try contradiction; [ exact I | |].
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & HE); split; [ exact (IH _ Hs) | split; [ reflexivity |] ].
    destruct E as [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ], E' as [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ]; cbn in HE |- *; try contradiction; destruct_all; auto.
  - destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & Hg); split; [ exact (IH _ Hs) | split; [ reflexivity | exact (IHg _ Hg) ] ].
Qed.

An open body unit, whose expanded body extends its context well.
Lemma desc_ok_body : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Δ Φ Φx R,
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Φ Φx -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ (body_ctx Φx ++ Δ) ++ Γ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ ((body_ctx Φx ++ Δ) ++ Γ) ->
    all_assumptions Δ -> body_shape Φx Φx -> List.NoDup (gm_names Φ) ->
    (forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H) ->
    body_shape Φ Φ -> forall l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δ l ->
    forall es, (forall y, type_sort (es y)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
       sort_kind (es y) (entry_kind E)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M σ, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
       gm_fill Φ0 = Some σ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : es y) ->
    forall lv Rt, levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv Rt ->
    (forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Ψ ++ Δ ++ Γ) H) ->
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ None (gu_open Δ Φ) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hx HΓ Hs Ha Hsh Hnd Ho Hsw l HRΔ es Hes Htg HA lv Rt Hlv Hff HR.
  assert (HUw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open nil Φ ≈ gu_open nil Φ).
  { assert (Hnil : forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, (nil : ctx) = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ T : Typeω@0)
      by (intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? E; discriminate).
    (* no parameter: the flag set holds of none *)
    assert (Hlv0 : levels_flag Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) nil (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) true Rt)
      by (constructor; [ intros _ [| ? ?] ? ? ? E; discriminate | discriminate | discriminate ]).
    apply unit_eq_of_full; eapply (unit_full_body _ _ (Δ ++ Γ) nil Φ Φx) with (l := 0) (ps := fun _ => Typeω@0);
      cbn [List.app]; try exact Hnil; try eassumption.
    all: first [ rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΓ; exact HΓ | constructor | intros ? ? _ Hk; cbn in Hk; lia ]. }
  inversion HR; subst.
  match goal with Hx' : body_xp _ _ _ Φ ?Φ0 |- _ =>
    rewrite <- (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hx _ Hx') in * end.
  match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
  eapply desc_ok_open with (param_level := l); [ | | | | | | | exact HRΔ | | ].
  8: { (* the definitions, filled in, at the sorts of their kinds *)
       intros * Hp HE Hf; destruct (sort_kind_abs_kind_sort_inv _ _ (Htg _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE)) as (i & Hi); exists i;
         rewrite <- Hi; exact (HA _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf). }
  8: { (* its entries can be read over the parameters, by the flag *)
       destruct Hlv as [Hsorted Hden Hnl]; destruct lv; [ left; exact (Hsorted eq_refl) | right ].
       pose proof (Hden eq_refl) as Hd; inversion Hd; subst; try (unfold gc_unit in *; cbn in *; discriminate).
       match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ (gu_open nil Φ) _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
       match goal with Hx' : body_xp _ _ _ Φ ?Φ0 |- _ =>
         cbn [List.app] in Hx'; rewrite <- (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hx _ Hx') in * end.
       match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
       exact (Hnl eq_refl). }
  - rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΓ; exact HΓ.
  - eapply body_xp_result_noopen; exact Hx.
  - intros y Φ0 E U Hp HE R0 HR0.
    destruct (gm_prefix_body_ctx _ _ _ (body_xp_result_noopen _ _ _ _ _ Hx) Hp) as (Ψ & HΨ).
    destruct E; cbn in HE; try discriminate; injection HE as ->;
      [ apply (Hs Ψ (ce_mod U) U (body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ)) | eapply (Hs Ψ (ce_dm _ _ U) U (body_ctx Φ0 ++ Δ ++ Γ)) ];
      first [ rewrite HΨ; cbn [body_ctx]; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | reflexivity | exact HR0 ].
  - exact Ha.
  - exact Hsh.
  - rewrite (body_xp_names _ _ _ _ _ Hx); exact Hnd.
  - exact HUw.
Qed.

Under its flag premise (levels_flag), what a module expression denotes over the parameters can be abstracted over them.
Lemma levels_flag_here : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Δ E lv Rt R,
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ E lv Rt -> mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E R -> desc_levels_abstractable Θ Ξ Γ Δ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * [Hsorted Hden Hnl] Hm; destruct lv; [ left; exact (Hsorted eq_refl) | right ].
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ (Hden eq_refl)); exact (Hnl eq_refl).
Qed.

An alias unit of a typed target, under its flag premise.
Lemma desc_ok_alias : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Δ E R l lv Rt, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ -> all_assumptions Δ ->
    params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δ l -> levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ E lv Rt ->
    (forall R0, mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E R0 -> desc_ok Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) R0) ->
    (Δ <> nil -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E) ->
    udenote Θ Ξ Γ None (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E)) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * HΓ Ha HRΔ Hlv HE Hff HR; inversion HR; subst.
  apply (desc_ok_up _ _ _ _ _ l); [| exact HΓ | exact Ha | apply up_evaluated_of; [ exact HRΔ | | ] ].
  - eapply desc_ok_mod; [ exact Hg | apply HE; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - eapply desc_levels_abstractable_mod; [ eapply levels_flag_here; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros Hne; destruct (Hff Hne) as (R1 & Hm1 & Hn1).
    match goal with Hm : mdenote _ _ _ E ?R0, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?R0 = Some _ |- _ =>
      rewrite <- (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ Hm1) in Hn1;
      intros Hr; exact (Hn1 (desc_reads_frame_mod _ _ _ Hmd Hr)) end.
Qed.

β Keeps Descriptions Typed


Lemma tele_view_last : forall L κ X, tele_view (L ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) = Some (X, L).
Proof. intros; unfold tele_view; rewrite List.rev_app_distr; cbn; rewrite List.rev_involutive; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma desc_ok_mtele_last : forall Θ Ξ Γ κ X R2, mdesc_is_mod R2 -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_up (ce_ass κ X :: nil) R2) ->
    exists T1, mdesc_mod_tele (mdesc_up (ce_ass κ X :: nil) R2) = Some (T1 ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil).
Proof.
  intros * Hm Hok; destruct R2 as [| Δ Φ | Θ' p T Φ Ns |]; cbn in Hm; try contradiction.
  - exists Δ; reflexivity.
  - inversion Hok as [| | Γ0 Θa T0 Φ1 Ns0 Θ0 Ξ0 p0 lΘ Hg0 Hsub Hloc Ha HsT HT HΘ' Hargs |]; subst.
    pose proof (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) as Hle.
    unfold mdesc_mod_tele; cbn; destruct (Nat.leb_spec (length Ns) (length T)) as [_ | ?]; [| lia ].
    eexists; rewrite List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma desc_ok_beta : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Δ κ X D N,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D ≈ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D ->
    (forall R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ None (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : X ->
    (forall R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) N) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R) /\
    (forall R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit (gu_mk Δ D)[Id,,N]ᵘ) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * HU HUok HN.
  assert (Hl : forall R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) N) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R).
  { intros R HR; inversion HR; subst; try (unfold gc_unit in *; cbn in *; discriminate).
    match goal with Hm : mdenote _ _ _ (me_lit _) ?R0, Ha : mdesc_at ?R0 N = Some R |- _ =>
      rename Ha into Hat; inversion Hm; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate) end.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ None _ ?R0 |- _ =>
      pose proof (HUok _ Hu) as Hok;
      destruct (udenote_last _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu) as (R2 & Hu2 & ->);
      destruct (desc_ok_mtele_last _ _ _ _ _ _ (udenote_is_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu2) Hok) as (T1 & Ht) end.
    exact (desc_ok_at _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hok Ht (tele_view_last _ _ _) HN Hat). }
  split; [ exact Hl |].
  intros R HR.
  destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & [R1 HR1] & _).
  destruct (mdenote_beta _ _ _ _ _ _ _ N HU _ HR1) as (R' & H1 & H2 & _).
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HR _ H2); exact (Hl _ H1).
Qed.

The description of a body unit read as its expansion is typed when the body's is: only the written body, which only typing and levels read, changes, and the expansion is a unit too (wf_unit_eq_expand).
Lemma desc_ok_open_expand : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Φ, desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_open Δ Φ (gm_expand Φ)) ->
    desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_open Δ (gm_expand Φ) (gm_expand Φ)).
Proof.
  intros * Hd; inversion Hd; subst.
  eapply desc_ok_open; try eassumption.
  (* the expansion is a unit *)
  all: try match goal with Hw : wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gu_open nil ?Φw) _ |- wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gu_open nil (gm_expand ?Φw)) _ =>
             pose proof (wf_unit_eq_expand _ _ _ _ _ Hw) as He;
             exact (wf_unit_eq_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_unit_eq_sym _ _ _ _ _ He) He) end.
  (* the levels premise reads the expansion only *)
  all: match goal with Hl : desc_levels_abstractable _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
         destruct Hl as [Hl | Hl]; [ left; exact Hl | right; inversion Hl; subst; econstructor; eassumption ] end.
Qed.

Over valid storage, every unit and module expression of a judgment denotes typed descriptions only, and so do the slots of its context.
Theorem desc_typed :
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> valid_syn Θ Ξ -> slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
     slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ /\ slots_typed Θ Ξ (Ψ ++ Γ) /\ slots_typed Θ Ξ (Ψ' ++ Γ)) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
     slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ /\ (forall R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R) /\
     (forall R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U' R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R)) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
     slots_typed Θ Ξ Γ /\ (forall R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R) /\
     (forall R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H' R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R)).
Proof.
  apply syntactic_wf_mut_ind; intros;
    match goal with Hv : valid_syn _ _ |- _ =>
      repeat match goal with IH : valid_syn _ _ -> _ |- _ => specialize (IH Hv) end end;
    destruct_conjs.
  all: try match goal with |- slots_typed _ _ ?G => solve [ assumption ] end.
  all: try solve [ apply slots_typed_nil ].
  all: try solve [ apply slots_typed_cons; [ assumption | first [ intros; discriminate | intros ? [= <-]; assumption ] ] ].
  all: try match goal with |- slots_typed _ _ _ /\ _ => split; [ assumption |] end.
  all: try solve [ cbn [List.app]; split; (apply slots_typed_cons;
      [ assumption | first [ intros; discriminate | intros ? [= <-]; assumption ] ]) ].
  all: try solve [ split; assumption ].
  all: assert (Hg : ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ) by
    (first [ eapply ctx_wf_gctx; eassumption | eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_modexp_eq_ctx; eassumption
           | eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_unit_eq_ctx; eassumption | eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_ext_eq_ctx; eassumption ]).
  - (* an open body unit: each side by its own extension *)
    match goal with Hb : body_shape ?Φ ?Φ', Hnd : List.NoDup (gm_names ?Φ),
                    Hx : body_xp _ _ _ ?Φ ?Φx, Hx' : body_xp _ _ _ ?Φ' ?Φx' |- _ =>
      assert (Hnd' : List.NoDup (gm_names Φ')) by (rewrite <- (body_shape_names _ _ Hb); exact Hnd);
      pose proof (body_shape_l _ _ Hb); pose proof (body_shape_r _ _ Hb) end.
    match goal with Hb : body_shape ?Φx ?Φx', Hx : body_xp _ _ _ _ ?Φx |- _ =>
      pose proof (body_shape_l _ _ Hb); pose proof (body_shape_r _ _ Hb) end.
    split; intros R HR;
      match goal with
      | Hx : body_xp _ _ _ ?Φ ?Φx, Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ (gu_open _ ?Φ) _,
        HX : wf_ext_eq _ _ _ (body_ctx ?Φx ++ ?Δ) _, Hs : slots_typed _ _ ((body_ctx ?Φx ++ ?Δ) ++ _),
        Ho : forall k Ψ H, nth_error (body_opens ?Φ ?Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> _ |- _ =>
          eapply desc_ok_body; [ exact Hg | exact Hx | exact (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HX) | exact Hs | assumption | assumption
                               | assumption | exact Ho | assumption
                               | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption | eassumption | eassumption
                               | | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | eassumption | exact Hu ]
      end.
    (* the definitions of each side, filled in, at their sorts *)
    all: match goal with
         | Hx : body_xp _ _ _ _ ?Φx, Hsx : body_shape ?Φx ?Φx', HP : forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σ σ', _ -> _ -> _ -> _ -> _ -> _ ->
             wf_exp _ _ _ _ A[σ] |- forall y Φ0 E A M σ, gm_prefix_upto ?Φx _ = _ -> _ =>
             exact (body_defs_left _ _ _ (body_xp_nopens _ _ _ _ _ Hx) Hsx HP)
         | Hx : body_xp _ _ _ _ ?Φx', Hsx : body_shape ?Φx ?Φx', HP : forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σ σ', _ -> _ -> _ -> _ -> _ -> _ ->
             wf_exp _ _ _ _ A'[σ'] |- forall y Φ0 E A M σ, gm_prefix_upto ?Φx' _ = _ -> _ =>
             intros y Φ0' E' A' M' σ' Hp' HE' Hf0';
             destruct (shape_prefix _ _ _ _ _ (body_shape_sym _ _ Hsx) Hp') as (Φ0 & E & Hp & _ & HS);
             destruct (body_shape_fill _ _ (body_xp_nopens _ _ _ _ _ Hx) (body_shape_sym _ _ Hsx)) as [_ Hf];
             destruct (fill_prefix _ _ _ _ Hf Hp) as (σ & Hf0);
             destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE') as (A0 & M0 & HE);
             eapply HP; eassumption
         end.
  - (* an alias unit *)
    split; intros R HR; eapply desc_ok_alias; try exact HR;
      first [ exact Hg | eapply presup_modexp_eq_ctx; eassumption | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption
            | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | assumption | intros _; assumption | eassumption ].
  - (* an alias of a literal, and the literal over both telescopes *)
    match goal with HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ (?Δ ++ ?Γ) (gu_mk ?Δ' ?D) _, Ha : all_assumptions ?Δ,
                    IH : forall R, udenote _ _ (?Δ ++ ?Γ) None (gu_mk ?Δ' ?D) R -> desc_ok _ _ _ R |- _ =>
      pose proof (presup_unit_eq_ctx HU) as HΔ;
      destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & (R0 & HR0) & _);
      split; intros R HR;
      [ eapply desc_ok_alias; [ exact Hg | exact HΔ | exact Ha | eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption
                              | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | | intros _; eassumption | exact HR ];
        intros R1 HR1; inversion HR1; subst; try (unfold gc_unit in *; cbn in *; discriminate); auto
      | pose proof (udenote_abs _ _ _ _ _ _ HR0) as Habs; cbn [gunit_abs] in Habs;
        rewrite (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)) _ _ _ _ HR _ Habs);
        eapply desc_ok_up; [ exact (IH _ HR0) | exact HΔ | exact Ha | apply up_evaluated_of ];
        [ eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption
        | eapply levels_flag_here; [ exact Hg | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | constructor; exact HR0 ]
        | (* the literal is no module still being defined *)
          intros _; match goal with Hff : frame_free_target _ _ _ (me_lit _) |- _ => destruct Hff as (R1 & Hm1 & Hn1) end;
          assert (HmL : mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D)) R0) by (constructor; exact HR0);
          rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HmL _ Hm1); exact Hn1 ] ]
    end.
  - (* a body unit and its expansion *)
    match goal with HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gu_open _ _) _, IH : forall R, udenote _ _ _ None (gu_open _ _) R -> _ |- _ =>
      split; [ exact IH |]; intros R HR;
      destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & (R0 & HR0) & _);
      pose proof (IH _ HR0) as Hok
    end.
    inversion HR0; subst.
    match goal with Hx : body_xp _ _ _ Φ _, Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some R0 |- _ =>
      cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <-; rewrite (body_xp_expand _ _ _ _ _ Hx) in Hok end.
    inversion HR; subst.
    match goal with Hx : body_xp _ _ _ (gm_expand Φ) _, Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some R |- _ =>
      cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <-; rewrite (body_xp_noopen_id _ _ _ _ _ (gm_noopen_expand _) Hx) end.
    exact (desc_ok_open_expand _ _ _ _ _ Hok).
  - (* a loaded unit or an open frame; a unit is the module of no member *)
    split; intros R0 HR0; inversion HR0; subst;
      [ eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption | exfalso | exfalso | eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption | exfalso | exfalso ];
      first [ match goal with Hk : gs_find_ind _ _ = Some _, Hq : mod_qname _ = Some _ |- _ =>
                cbn in Hq; injection Hq as <-; destruct (frame_ind_parent _ _ Hg _ _ Hk) as ([? cq] & ? & Hp) end
            | match goal with Hk : gs_find_record _ _ = Some _, Hq : mod_qname _ = Some _ |- _ =>
                cbn in Hq; injection Hq as <-; destruct (frame_record_parent _ _ Hg _ _ Hk) as ([? cq] & ? & Hp) end ];
      unfold qname_in in Hp; cbn in Hp; injection Hp as _ Hc; destruct cq; discriminate.
  - (* a slot *)
    split; intros R HR; inversion HR; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate); first [ eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption |
      match goal with Hl : ctx_lookup_mod _ ?U0 _, HU : udenote _ _ _ _ ?U0 _ |- _ =>
        exact (slots_typed_lookup _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl H H0 _ HU) end ].
  - (* a literal *)
    pose proof (presup_unit_eq_ctx H).
    split; intros R HR; inversion HR; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate); first [ eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption | auto ].
  - (* a member *)
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx H0).
    split; intros R0 HR0; [ exact (desc_ok_mem _ _ Hg H6 _ _ _ _ H9 H7 HR0) | exact (desc_ok_mem _ _ Hg H6 _ _ _ _ H9 H8 HR0) ].
  - (* an application *)
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx H0).
    split; intros R0 HR0; inversion HR0; subst;
      [ eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption | cbn in *; discriminate | | cbn in *; discriminate
      | eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption | cbn in *; discriminate | | cbn in *; discriminate ].
    (* each side: the head's description, typed, given the argument *)
    all: match goal with Hm : mdenote _ _ _ ?H0 ?R1, Ha : mdesc_at ?R1 _ = Some _,
                         Ht : mdesc_mod_tele ?R2 = Some _, Hm2 : mdenote _ _ _ ?H0 ?R2,
                         IH : forall R, mdenote _ _ _ ?H0 R -> desc_ok _ _ _ R |- _ =>
           rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ Hm2) in Ha;
           eapply desc_ok_at; [ exact Hg | exact (IH _ Hm2) | exact Ht | eassumption | eassumption | exact Ha ] end.
  - (* a slot is its unit *)
    split; intros R HR; inversion HR; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate); first [ eapply desc_ok_unit; eassumption |
      match goal with Hl : ctx_lookup_mod _ ?U0 _, HU : udenote _ _ _ _ ?U0 _ |- _ =>
        exact (slots_typed_lookup _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl H H0 _ HU) end
      | match goal with HU : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _, Hl : ctx_lookup_mod _ _ _ |- _ =>
        exact (slots_typed_lookup _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl H H0 _ HU) end ].
The δ-sel rule: the new reflexivity premise on mdesc_unit Rm now supplies the induction hypothesis for the right side, so the case is closed by the shared split; assumption above.
  - (* β for a body *)
    match goal with HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ _ _ _, HN : wf_exp _ _ _ _ ?N, HUok : forall R, udenote _ _ _ _ _ R -> _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (desc_ok_beta _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ N HU HUok HN) as Hb end.
    rewrite gunit_sub_mk in Hb; cbn [moddef_sub] in Hb; exact Hb.
  - (* β for an alias *)
    match goal with HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ _ _ _, HN : wf_exp _ _ _ _ ?N, HUok : forall R, udenote _ _ _ _ _ R -> _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (desc_ok_beta _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ N HU HUok HN) as Hb end.
    rewrite gunit_sub_mk in Hb; cbn [moddef_sub] in Hb; exact Hb.
  - (* an alias with no parameter is its target *)
    split; [| assumption ].
    intros R HR; inversion HR; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate).
    match goal with HE : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ E E |- _ => eapply (desc_ok_alias _ _ Hg _ nil E _ 0 true R);
      [ exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE) | constructor | apply params_evaluated_nil
      | constructor; [ intros _ [| ? ?] ? ? ? Heq; discriminate | discriminate | discriminate ]
      | cbn; assumption | let Hne := fresh "Hne" in intros Hne; contradiction (Hne eq_refl) | eassumption ] end.
Qed.

The term part of a typed description is of a type, and its δ-reduct of that type.
Lemma desc_ok_ty_sorted : forall Θ Ξ, valid_syn Θ Ξ -> forall Γ R A, desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    (exists S, type_sort S /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : S) /\ (forall M, mdesc_reduct R = Some M -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A).
Proof.
  intros * Hv * HR HA.
  destruct HR as [Γ r A0 om i0 HA0 HM | | | Γ Θd A0 M0 Rm lΘ iA HΘd HaΘd HBt HMt _];
    cbn in HA |- *; try discriminate.
  - injection HA as <-; split; [| exact HM ].
    exact (ex_intro _ _ (conj (type_sort_abs_kind r _ (type_sort_universe i0)) HA0)).
  - (* a definition with a module part, or a type former: its term part *)
    injection HA as <-.
    destruct (ctx_pi_type _ _ ak_relevant _ _ _ _ ltac:(discriminate) HΘd HBt) as [[j Hty] Hfn].
    split; [ exact (ex_intro _ _ (conj (type_sort_universe j) Hty)) | intros M [= <-]; exact (Hfn _ HMt) ].
Qed.

The type of a member with both a term part and a module part is of a large universe: the term part of a definition with a module part is relevant, and not a level.
Lemma desc_ok_ty_mod : forall Θ Ξ Γ R A Rm, desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R -> mdesc_type R = Some A -> mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
    exists j, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@j.
Proof.
  intros * HR HA Hm.
  destruct HR as [Γ r A0 om i0 HA0 HM | | | Γ Θd A0 M0 Rm0 lΘ iA HΘd HaΘd HBt HMt _];
    cbn in HA, Hm |- *; try discriminate.
  injection HA as <-; destruct (ctx_pi_type _ _ ak_relevant _ _ _ _ ltac:(discriminate) HΘd HBt) as [[j Hty] _]; exists j; exact Hty.
Qed.

The type of a typed description's term part is of the sort of its kind next to a large universe.
Lemma desc_ok_ty_at : forall Θ Ξ Γ R A, desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort (mdesc_kind R) Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HR HA.
  destruct HR as [Γ r A0 om i0 HA0 HM | | | Γ Θd A0 M0 Rm lΘ iA HΘd HaΘd HBt HMt _];
    cbn in HA |- *; try discriminate.
  - injection HA as <-; exists i0; exact HA0.
  - injection HA as <-; destruct (ctx_pi_type _ _ ak_relevant _ _ _ _ ltac:(discriminate) HΘd HBt) as [[j Hty] _].
    exists j; exact Hty.
Qed.

What a Member Looks Up is Typed

A Filed Member at Arguments is Typed


Lemma mdesc_type_up : forall Δ R A, mdesc_type R = Some A -> mdesc_type (mdesc_up Δ R) = Some (ctx_pi_at (mdesc_kind R) Δ A).
Proof.
  intros * Ht; destruct R as [r A0 om | | | Θd A0 M0 Rm]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
  - injection Ht as <-; reflexivity.
  - injection Ht as <-; rewrite ctx_pi_app; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_kind_sub : forall R σ, mdesc_kind (mdesc_sub R σ) = mdesc_kind R.
Proof. intros [] ?; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma mdesc_kind_up : forall Δ R, mdesc_kind (mdesc_up Δ R) = mdesc_kind R.
Proof. intros ? []; reflexivity. Qed.

Typed Descriptions Grow with the Global Context


Lemma gctx_embedding_preserves_args_ok : forall Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 Γ T Ns, gctx_embedding Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 -> args_ok Θ1 Ξ1 Γ T Ns -> args_ok Θ2 Ξ2 Γ T Ns.
Proof.
  intros * He [T1 T2 HT Hl Ha Hs HT2 HN].
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (Hc & Ht & _).
  exists T1 T2; [ exact HT | exact Hl | exact Ha | exact Hs | exact (Hc _ HT2) | intros; apply Ht; eauto ].
Qed.

A description that can be abstracted over Δ grows into one that can: parameters of types of levels stay so, and a description with no member of a type of levels grows into itself (no_level_grows_eq).
Lemma desc_levels_abstractable_grow : forall Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2, gctx_embedding Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    forall Γ Δ R1 R2, desc_levels_abstractable Θ1 Ξ1 Γ Δ R1 -> mdesc_grows Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 R1 R2 ->
    desc_levels_abstractable Θ2 Ξ2 Γ Δ R2.
Proof.
  intros * He * [HL | HN] Hd; destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (_ & Ht & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & Hnl).
  - left; exact HL.
  - right; rewrite (no_level_grows_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_resolution _ _ _ _ He) Hd _ (or_introl HN)).
    exact (Hnl _ _ HN).
Qed.

What a description grows into, read at a bigger global context, is typed there.
Lemma desc_ok_grow : forall Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2, ⊢ᵍ Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 -> gctx_embedding Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    forall Γ R1, desc_ok Θ1 Ξ1 Γ R1 -> forall R2, mdesc_grows Θ1 Ξ1 Θ2 Ξ2 R1 R2 -> desc_ok Θ2 Ξ2 Γ R2.
Proof.
  intros * Hg1 He; pose proof (gctx_embedding_wf _ _ _ _ He) as Hg2; pose proof (gctx_embedding_resolution _ _ _ _ He) as Hs.
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (Hc & Ht & _ & _ & _ & Hu & _).
  induction 1 as [Γ r A om iA HA HM
                 | Γ Δ Φw Φ lΔ HΦ Hn Hent IH HaΔ Hsh Hnd HUw HRΔ Htg HLΔ
                 | Γ Θ' T Φ Ns Θ0 Ξ0 p lΘ Hg0 Hs0 Hloc Ha Hsc HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ HRΘ HLΘ HFΘ
                 | Γ Θd A M Rm lΘ iA HΘd HaΘd HBt HMt HRm IH HRΘd HLΘd HFΘd];
    intros R2 Hd.
  4: { (* a definition with a module part, or a type former: its module
          part grows *)
       inversion Hd as [? Hcb | | ? ? ? R1' R2' Hd']; subst.
       - (* reading no closed body *)
         assert (Hcb' : mdesc_closedb Rm = false) by (cbn in Hcb; rewrite mdesc_closedb_up in Hcb; exact Hcb).
         econstructor; [ apply Hc, HΘd | exact HaΘd | exact (Ht _ _ _ HBt) | apply Ht, HMt |
                       | exact (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He HRΘd)
                       | eapply desc_levels_abstractable_grow; [ exact He | exact HLΘd | apply mdesc_grows_same ]
                       | intros Hne; exact (frame_free_grows _ _ _ _ Hs _ _ (mdesc_grows_same _ _ _ _ _ Hcb') (HFΘd Hne)) ].
         + apply IH, mdesc_grows_same; exact Hcb'.
         + cbn in Hcb |- *; rewrite mdesc_closedb_up in Hcb; exact Hcb.
       - destruct (mdesc_grows_up_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hd') as (Rm' & -> & HRm').
         econstructor; [ apply Hc, HΘd | exact HaΘd | exact (Ht _ _ _ HBt) | apply Ht, HMt | exact (IH _ HRm')
                       | exact (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He HRΘd)
                       | eapply desc_levels_abstractable_grow; [ exact He | exact HLΘd | constructor; exact HRm' ]
                       | intros Hne; exact (frame_free_grows _ _ _ _ Hs _ _ HRm' (HFΘd Hne)) ]. }
  all: inversion Hd as [? Hcb | Θ'' T' Φ1 Φ2 Ns' p' Hl1 Hl2 |]; subst; try (cbn in Hcb; discriminate).
  - econstructor; [ exact (Ht _ _ _ HA) | intros M HM0; apply Ht, HM, HM0 ].
  - econstructor; [ apply Hc, HΦ | exact Hn | | exact HaΔ | exact Hsh | exact Hnd | apply Hu, HUw
                  | exact (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He HRΔ)
                  | intros * Hp HE Hf; destruct (Htg _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf) as (j & Hj);
                    exists j; exact (Ht _ _ _ Hj)
                  | eapply desc_levels_abstractable_grow; [ exact He | exact HLΔ | apply mdesc_grows_same; reflexivity ] ].
    intros y Φ0 E U Hp HE R HR.
    destruct (gm_prefix_body_ctx _ _ _ Hn Hp) as (Ψ & HΨ).
    rewrite HΨ in HΦ.
    pose proof (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΦ; exact HΦ)) as HΦ0.
    destruct (body_ext_unit_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ0 HE) as [_ HU].
    destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & [R1 HR1] & _).
    destruct (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_grow_all _ _ _ _ Hg1 Hg2 Hs)) _ _ _ _ HR1 (or_introl eq_refl)) as (R1' & HR1' & Hd1).
    rewrite (proj1 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg2)) _ _ _ _ HR _ HR1').
    exact (IH _ _ _ _ Hp HE _ HR1 _ Hd1).
  - eapply desc_ok_closed; [ exact Hg2 | apply gc_sub_refl | exact Hl2 | exact Ha | exact Hsc
                  | apply Hc, HT | apply Hc, HΘ' | exact (gctx_embedding_preserves_args_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He Hargs) | exact HaΘ
                  | exact (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He HRΘ)
                  | eapply desc_levels_abstractable_grow; [ exact He | exact HLΘ | constructor; eassumption ] |].
    intros Hne; apply (proj1 (closed_frame_free_iff Ξ2 Θ' p T Φ2 Ns)).
    exact (frame_free_grows _ _ _ _ Hs _ _ Hd (proj2 (closed_frame_free_iff Ξ1 Θ' p T Φ Ns) (HFΘ Hne))).
Qed.

Presupposition of Typing, over Valid Storage


Corollary mem_desc_ok : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H' x R, valid_syn Θ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hv HH Hm.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) as HΓ.
  destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 desc_typed)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HH Hv) as (_ & HR & _).
  exact (desc_ok_mem _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) Hv _ _ _ _ HΓ HR Hm).
Qed.

A Π of the kinds κd and κc (pi_kinds), from a domain of a sort of κd and a codomain of the sort of κc next to a large universe, as the rules of functions take them: a type.
Lemma wf_type_pi : forall Θ Ξ Γ κd κc A B Srt i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt -> sort_kind Srt κd ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i -> pi_kinds κd κc ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ a_pi κd κc A B.
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hk; destruct HS as [k | |].
  - exact (wf_type_kind (wf_pi_at_max _ _ _ ak_relevant κc _ _ _ _ HA HB Hk)).
  - eapply wf_type_kind; eapply wf_pi with (U := Typeω@i) (κd := ak_propositional) (κc := κc);
      [ apply wf_is_univ_large; eapply presup_exp_ctx, HA | exact HA | rewrite abs_kind_sort_wk; exact HB | exact Hk ].
  - eapply wf_type_kind; eapply wf_pi with (U := Typeω@i) (κd := ak_level) (κc := κc);
      [ apply wf_is_univ_large; eapply presup_exp_ctx, HA | exact HA | rewrite abs_kind_sort_wk; exact HB | exact Hk ].
Qed.

The sort of the types of levels is of no type: no rule types it, and the conversion rule would need a type it is converted from.
Lemma level_sort_untyped : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A}, ~ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ LevelSort : A.
Proof.
  intros * H.
  dependent induction H; eauto.
Qed.

The formers of the types of levels: Level@n and the Πs between types of levels. These are the only terms of the sort LevelSort (presup_exp_typ_cases).
Inductive level_type_former : exp -> Prop :=
Level@n
| level_type_former_level : forall n, level_type_former (Level@n)
A Π between types of levels
| level_type_former_pi : forall A B, level_type_former (a_pi ak_level ak_level A B).

The type of a typed term: of a sort, or the sort LevelSort itself, and then the term is the former of a type of levels.
Inductive typ_presup (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (M : exp) : typ -> Prop :=
A type of a sort
| typ_presup_sorted : forall A S, type_sort S -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : S -> typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A
LevelSort, at a type of levels
| typ_presup_level_sort : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> level_type_former M -> typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M LevelSort.
Arguments typ_presup_sorted {Θ Ξ Γ M A}.
Arguments typ_presup_level_sort {Θ Ξ Γ M}.

A type of a large universe
Lemma typ_presup_univ : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A i}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A.
Proof. intros * H; exact (typ_presup_sorted _ (type_sort_universe i) H). Qed.

One of a large universe given by a level that exists
Lemma typ_presup_of_ex : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A}, (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i) -> typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A.
Proof. intros * [i Hi]; exact (typ_presup_univ Hi). Qed.

A proposition
Lemma typ_presup_prop : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Propₘ -> typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A.
Proof. intros * H; exact (typ_presup_sorted _ type_sort_prop H). Qed.

A type other than LevelSort
Lemma typ_presup_of_wf_type : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A -> A <> LevelSort -> typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A.
Proof. intros * [? S HS HA | HΓ] Hn; [ exact (typ_presup_sorted _ HS HA) | contradiction (Hn eq_refl) ]. Qed.

The type of a typed term is a type (⊢ᵗ), at its two cases.
Lemma presup_exp_typ_cases_v : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
    typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros Hv;
    repeat match goal with IH : valid_syn _ _ -> _ |- _ => specialize (IH Hv) end;
    assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ) by mauto 2; destruct_conjs.
  (* the types the induction hypotheses give, by their sorts; a premise's
     type premised of a sort is not LevelSort *)
  all: repeat match goal with H : typ_presup _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
    let S := fresh "S" in let HS := fresh "HS" in let HT := fresh "HT" in
    inversion H as [? S HS HT | ? ?]; subst; clear H end.
  all: try solve [ exfalso; eapply level_sort_untyped; eassumption ].
  (* a member: the type the unit binds it at *)
  all: try match goal with
    | Hm : mdenote _ _ _ (me_mem ?H0 _) ?R, Ht : mdesc_type ?R = Some _, HH : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵐ ?H0 ≈ _ |- _ =>
        let S := fresh "S" in let HS := fresh "HS" in let HT := fresh "HT" in
        destruct (proj1 (desc_ok_ty_sorted _ _ Hv _ _ _ (mem_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv HH Hm) Ht)) as (S & HS & HT);
        exact (typ_presup_sorted _ HS HT)
    end.
  (* inductive types: the declaration's types are types, and the motive at
     the scrutinee *)
  all: try match goal with
    | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ _ = Some ?D, HΓ : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ |- _ =>
        pose proof (ind_lookup_valid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj1 Hv) (proj2 Hv) Hl) as HDt; cbn [syn_VD] in HDt;
        pose proof (gctx_closed_ind _ _ _ _ (wf_gctx_closed _ _ _ HΓ) Hl) as HDc
    end.
  all: try solve [ apply typ_presup_of_ex; eapply ind_ty_typed; eassumption ].
  (* a constructor: its type is a closed type *)
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HM : ind_member ?D ?k = Some ?M, Hcon : ind_con ?M _ = Some _, Hty : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ con_ty _ ?D ?k ?M _ : _ |- _ =>
        eapply typ_presup_univ; eapply closed_weaken_exp;
          [ eassumption | exact Hty | eapply decl_closed_con_ty; [ eassumption | exact HM | apply cons_lookup_in; exact Hcon ]
          | exact I ]
    end ].
  (* an elimination: the motive of the member at the scrutinee *)
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hm : ind_member ?D ?m = Some ?Mm, Hb : nth_error ?Bks ?m = Some ?bm,
      HA : forall k Mk b, ind_member ?D k = Some Mk -> nth_error ?Bks k = Some b -> _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ eb_motive b : ?S,
      Hx : forall k Mk, ind_member ?D k = Some Mk -> _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ˣ _ ≈ _
      |- typ_presup _ _ _ _ (eb_motive ?bm)[_] =>
        apply (typ_presup_sorted S); [ first [ assumption | constructor | apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor ]
                              | eapply (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HA _ _ _ Hm Hb));
                                [ first [ assumption | constructor | apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor ] |] ];
        eapply wf_elim_inst_sub;
          [ eassumption | exact Hm | assumption | assumption | assumption | eapply ext_eq_ctx_left; exact (Hx _ _ Hm) ]
    end ].
  (* a record's type former: its type is a closed type *)
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hl : record_lookup _ _ _ = Some ?R, Hty : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ record_ty ?R : _, HΓ : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ |- _ =>
        eapply typ_presup_univ; eapply closed_weaken_exp;
          [ exact HΓ | exact Hty | apply record_ty_scoped; eapply wf_record_closed; eassumption | exact I ]
    end ].
  (* a type of a premised sort *)
  all: try solve [ eapply typ_presup_sorted; [| eassumption ]; eassumption ].
  (* a Π at its kinds: of the sort of its codomain's kind *)
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HA : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ ?A : ?S, HS : sort_kind ?S ?kd,
      HB : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ ▹{?kd} ?A ⊢ ?B : abs_kind_sort ?kc Typeω@?i, Hk : pi_kinds ?kd ?kc
      |- typ_presup _ _ ?Γ _ (a_pi ?kd ?kc ?A ?B) =>
        exact (typ_presup_of_wf_type (wf_type_pi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS HB Hk) ltac:(discriminate))
    end ].
  (* an application: the codomain at the argument, of the codomain's sort *)
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HA : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ ?A : ?S, HS : sort_kind ?S ?kd,
      HB : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ ▹{?kd} ?A ⊢ ?B : abs_kind_sort ?kc Typeω@?i, HN : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Γ ⊢ ?N : ?A
      |- typ_presup _ _ ?Γ _ ?B[Id,,?N] =>
        assert (HS' : type_sort (abs_kind_sort kc Typeω@i)) by (apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor);
        apply (typ_presup_sorted _ HS'); eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HB | exact HS' | eapply wf_sub_single; eassumption ]
    end ].
  (* a type of levels is of the sort of the types of levels *)
  all: try solve [ apply (typ_presup_sorted LevelSort); [ constructor | constructor; assumption ] ].
  all: destruct_type_sort.
  (* The goal-directed cases first, so that only the goals left reach the
     mauto searches below, whose failures dominated this proof. *)
  (* a universe is a type; a variable is of a type of the context *)
  all: try solve [ match goal with HU : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵤ ?U |- typ_presup _ _ _ _ ?U =>
                     destruct (wf_is_univ_typ HU) as [? ?]; eapply typ_presup_univ; eassumption end ].
  (* a type under a substitution, of its sort *)
  all: try solve [ match goal with HT : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ ?C : ?S |- typ_presup _ _ _ _ ?C[?σ] =>
                     apply (typ_presup_sorted S); [ constructor | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HT | constructor | mauto 3 ] ] end ].
  (* the sort of the types of levels: Level@n and a Π between types of
     levels *)
  all: try solve [ apply typ_presup_level_sort; [ mauto 2 | constructor ] ].
  all: try solve [ match goal with Hl : _ ∋ #_ : _, HΓ : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ |- _ =>
         let S := fresh "S" in let HS := fresh "HS" in let HT := fresh "HT" in
         destruct (ctx_lookup_wf_sorted _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as (S & HS & HT); exact (typ_presup_sorted _ HS HT) end ].
  (* A type of a proposition first: tried first, the universe search
     failed on each of the 130 goals of a proposition, at 0.1 s each. *)
  all: try solve [ eapply typ_presup_prop; mauto 3 ].
  all: eapply typ_presup_univ; mauto 3.
Qed.

Lemma presup_exp_typ_v : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    valid_syn Θ Ξ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof.
  intros * H Hv; destruct (presup_exp_typ_cases_v H Hv) as [? S HS HT | HΓ _];
    [ exact (wf_type_of_sort _ HS HT) | exact (wf_type_level_sort HΓ) ].
Qed.

Storage is Valid


Lemma syn_valid_here : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ.
Proof. intros * Hg HG; exact (HG _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_refl _ _ Hg) _ _ (gc_sub_refl _ _)). Qed.

Lemma syn_tele_all_assumptions : forall Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2, bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> all_assumptions (gs_tele Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * HG He; destruct (HG _ _ He _ _ (gc_sub_refl _ _)) as [_ HΞ].
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ]; [ constructor | exact (syn_F_ass _ _ _ (proj1 HΞ)) ].
Qed.

Lemma syn_def : forall Θ Ξ T r A M i b pv Θ2 Ξ2,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters T) ->
      
The telescope is of assumptions, so that the definition's filed body has no let at a type of levels (ctx_pi_type_kind)
      all_assumptions T ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ M : A -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    gds_valid syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 Θ -> gs_valid syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 Ξ ->
    forall (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack), syn_V Θ2 Ξ2 T (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r T A) (Some (ctx_fn T M))).
Proof.
  intros * HA HL _ HM HG He _ _ Θs Ξs.
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (_ & Ht & _).
  exists A; split; [ reflexivity |]; split; [ exact (mk_type_of_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ i HL (Ht _ _ _ HA)) |].
  intros ? [= <-]; exists M; split; [ reflexivity | apply Ht, HM ].
Qed.

Lemma syn_ax : forall Θ Ξ r A i b pv Θ2 Ξ2 (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack),
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    r <> ak_level ->
      
The frames' parameters are assumptions (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions)
      all_assumptions (gs_tele Ξ) ->
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ ->
    gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> gc_sub Θ Ξ Θs Ξs ->
    syn_V Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r (gs_tele Ξ) A) None).
Proof.
  intros * HA Hr _ _ He _; destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He)) as (_ & Ht & _).
  exists A; split; [ reflexivity |]; split; [| discriminate ].
  exact (mk_type_of_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ i (fun E => match Hr E with end) (Ht _ _ _ HA)).
Qed.

An alias: what its target denotes, wherever it is read, is typed.
Lemma syn_alias : forall Θ Ξ pv Δ E l (lv : bool) Rt Θ2 Ξ2 (Θs : gdeps) (Ξs : gstack),
    all_assumptions Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
    params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
    levels_flag Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E lv Rt ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E ->
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> gc_sub Θ Ξ Θs Ξs ->
    syn_V Θ2 Ξ2 (gs_tele Ξ) (ge_mod pv (gu_mk (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias E))).
Proof.
  intros * HaΔ Hx HE HRΔ [HL1 Hm1 Hn1] (Rf & Hmf & Hnf) HG He _; cbn [syn_V].
  rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hm1, Hn1.
  pose proof (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) as He'.
  pose proof (gctx_embedding_wf _ _ _ _ He') as Hg2.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE)) as Hg.
  pose proof (syn_valid_here _ _ Hg HG) as Hv.
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He') as (Hc & Ht & _ & _ & _ & _ & Hme & Hnl).
  pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as HΔ.
  split; [ exact (Hme _ _ _ HE) |].
  split; [ exact (Hc _ HΔ) |].
  (* the parameters, relevant over the frames' parameters, which are *)
  split.
  { destruct (wf_gs_tele_evaluated _ _ Hg) as [l0 H0].
    exists (max l l0); apply (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He').
    apply params_evaluated_app; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HRΔ | exact H0 ]. }
  (* the flag premise, moved *)
  split.
  { exists lv, Rt; constructor; [ | rewrite List.app_nil_r .. ].
    - intros Hl; exact (HL1 Hl).
    - intros Hl; exact (gctx_embedding_mdenote_no_level _ _ _ _ Hg He' _ _ _ (Hm1 Hl) (Hn1 Hl)).
    - intros Hl; exact (Hnl _ _ (Hn1 Hl)). }
  intros Γ HΓ.
  destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 desc_typed)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HE Hv) as (_ & HR & _).
  destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (_ & (R1 & R1m & HR1 & HR1m) & _).
  destruct (proj1 (mdenote_grow_all _ _ _ _ Hg Hg2 (gctx_embedding_resolution _ _ _ _ He')) _ _ _ HR1) as (R2 & HR2 & Hd).
  pose proof (desc_ok_grow _ _ _ _ Hg He' _ _ (HR _ HR1) _ Hd) as Hok2.
  destruct (mdesc_grows_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hd HR1m) as (R2m & HR2m & _).
  pose proof (Hme _ _ _ HE) as HE2.
  destruct (mdenote_tele_weaken _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE2 HΓ HR2) as (HR2' & HsR2).
  split; [ exists R2; exact HR2' |].
  intros R Hm.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg2) _ _ _ Hm _ HR2').
  split; [| split; [ exists R2m; exact HR2m |] ].
  2:{ (* it is no module still being defined, and stays so *)
