      rewrite <- (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HR1 _ Hmf) in Hnf.
      exact (frame_free_grows _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_resolution _ _ _ _ He') _ _ Hd Hnf). }
  pose proof (desc_ok_tele_weaken _ _ Hg2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) Γ nil R2) as Hw.
  rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hw.
  apply Hw; [ exact (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ (Hc _ HΔ)) | exact (Hc _ HΔ) | exact HΓ | exact HsR2 | exact Hok2 ].
Qed.

Lemma syn_nil : forall Θ Ξ Δ l Θ2 Ξ2,
    all_assumptions Δ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    syn_F Θ2 Ξ2 (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * HΔ HC HRΔ HG He.
  pose proof (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) as He'.
  destruct (wf_gs_tele_evaluated _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HC)) as [l0 H0].
  eapply mk_syn_F with (syn_F_level := max l l0).
  - apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact HΔ | exact (syn_tele_all_assumptions _ _ _ _ HG He) ].
  - exact (proj1 (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He') _ HC).
  - apply (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He').
    apply params_evaluated_app; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HRΔ | exact H0 ].
Qed.

Lemma syn_ind : forall Θ Ξ D l Θ2 Ξ2,
    decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (ind_uparams D) l ->
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    syn_VD Θ2 Ξ2 D /\ syn_F Θ2 Ξ2 (ind_uparams D).
Proof.
  intros * HD HRU _ He.
  pose proof (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) as He'.
  pose proof (gctx_embedding_preserves_decl_typed _ _ _ _ _ He' HD) as HD2.
  destruct (decl_typed_uparams _ _ _ HD2) as [HU HaU].
  split; [ exact HD2 | exact (mk_syn_F _ _ _ HaU HU l (params_evaluated_embed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ He' HRU)) ].
Qed.

A record: its declaration, typed where it is checked, moved along.
Lemma syn_record : forall Θ Ξ R l Θ2 Ξ2,
    record_typed Θ Ξ R -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil (record_params R) l ->
    bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> syn_VR Θ2 Ξ2 R.
Proof. intros * HR _ _ He; exact (gctx_embedding_preserves_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) HR). Qed.

A record's module telescope, where the record is found: the value's type is typed there.
Lemma syn_record_tele : forall Θ Ξ p R Θ2 Ξ2,
    record_typed Θ Ξ R -> bodies_valid_along_embeddings syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding_with_bodies Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> record_lookup Θ2 Ξ2 p = Some R ->
    syn_F Θ2 Ξ2 (record_params R) -> syn_F Θ2 Ξ2 (record_mod_tele p R).
Proof.
  intros * HR _ He Hl [Ha _ lP HRP].
  pose proof (gctx_embedding_preserves_record_typed _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_embedding_with_bodies_embedding _ _ _ _ He) HR) as HR2.
  destruct (record_self_large _ _ _ _ HR2 Hl) as [j Hj].
  eapply mk_syn_F with (syn_F_level := max j lP).
  - constructor; [ do 2 eexists; reflexivity | exact Ha ].
  - exact (record_mod_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HR2 Hl).
  - unfold record_mod_tele.
    change (ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self p R) :: record_params R) with ((ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self p R) :: nil) ++ record_params R).
    apply params_evaluated_app; [| exact HRP ].
    intros Δ1 κ T Δ2 E; destruct Δ1 as [| e Δ1]; cbn in E; [| destruct Δ1; discriminate ].
    injection E as <- <- <-; rewrite List.app_nil_r; left; exact Hj.
Qed.

Everything stored in a well-formed global context is valid there.
Theorem gctx_valid_syn : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> valid_syn Θ Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * Hg; apply (syn_valid_here _ _ Hg).
  exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2
           (global_valid_all syn_Vs syn_F syn_VD syn_VR syn_def syn_ax syn_alias syn_nil syn_ind syn_record
              syn_record_tele))))))))))) _ _ Hg).
Qed.

A term a well-formed module expression looks up is typed at the type the lookup reads: the premises of wf_mem on the type and on the δ-reduct hold of every description looked up (mem_desc_ok). The checker supplies them so, without reading a body again.
Corollary wf_mem_desc : forall Θ Ξ Γ H x R A,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H x : A.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm Ht.
  pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH))) as Hv.
  destruct (desc_ok_ty_sorted _ _ Hv _ _ _ (mem_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv HH Hm) Ht) as [(S & HS & Hi) HM].
  eapply wf_mem; [ exact HH | exact Hm | exact Ht | exact Hi | exact HS | exact HM ].
Qed.

Telescopes Below a Stored Body

An alias just below a stored body, an open frame or a closed module, is stored over the body's telescope extended.
Lemma loc_alias_params : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p T Φ y U, gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) ->
    gc_module Θ Ξ (qname_in p y) = Some (mr_alias U) -> exists Δ, gu_params U = Δ ++ T /\ all_assumptions Δ.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hl Hm; unfold gc_loc in Hl; destruct (gc_frame Ξ p) as [r |] eqn:Hf.
  - injection Hl as ->; unfold gc_frame in Hf.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] [| ? ?]] T0] |] eqn:Ef; try discriminate.
    injection Hf as <- <-.
    unfold gc_module, gc_module_u in Hm.
    destruct (gs_find_tele_child _ _ Hg _ _ _ Ef y) as [(V & T1 & Ef') | Ef']; rewrite Ef' in Hm; [ discriminate |].
    destruct (gm_coherent_child _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_coherent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Ef) Hm) as [(? & ? & [=] & _) | (U' & Δ' & [= <-] & HU & HΔ)].
    eauto.
  - destruct (gc_body_module _ _ _ _ _ Hl) as [oD Hmd].
    rewrite qname_in_app in Hm; exact (wf_gc_alias_params _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ Hmd Hm).
Qed.

A stored body just below a stored body is over the body's telescope extended.
Lemma loc_child_tele : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p T Φ y T' Φ', gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) ->
    gc_loc Θ Ξ (qname_in p y) = Some (T', Φ') -> exists Δ, T' = Δ ++ T /\ all_assumptions Δ.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hl Hl'; unfold gc_loc in Hl; destruct (gc_frame Ξ p) as [r |] eqn:Hf.
  - injection Hl as ->; unfold gc_frame in Hf.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] [| ? ?]] T0] |] eqn:Ef; try discriminate.
    injection Hf as <- <-.
    destruct (gs_find_tele_child _ _ Hg _ _ _ Ef y) as [(V & T1 & Ef') | Ef'].
    + unfold gc_loc, gc_frame, gc_body in Hl'; rewrite Ef' in Hl'.
      destruct V as [Δv [[|] Φv | Ev]]; try discriminate; injection Hl' as <- <-.
      assert (Hv : loc Θ Ξ (qname_in p y) (Δv ++ T1) Φv) by (left; unfold gc_frame; rewrite Ef'; reflexivity).
      destruct (gs_find_tele_frame _ _ Hg _ _ _ Ef') as [(Hc & _) | (c & y' & V' & T2 & Hc & HV & _ & ->)];
        cbn in Hc; [ destruct (q_chain p); discriminate |].
      apply List.app_inj_tail in Hc as [<- <-].
      cbn [q_unit qname_in] in HV; replace (q_abs (q_unit p) (q_chain p)) with p in HV by (destruct p; reflexivity).
      rewrite Ef in HV; injection HV as <- <-; cbn [gu_params] in Hv |- *.
      destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) Hv) as [[Ha _ _ _] _].
      exists Δv; split; [ reflexivity | unfold all_assumptions in Ha; exact (proj1 (proj1 (List.Forall_app _ _ _) Ha)) ].
    + unfold gc_loc, gc_frame, gc_body in Hl'; rewrite Ef' in Hl'; cbn [gu_params gu_mod] in Hl'.
      exact (proj2 (gm_coherent_subbody _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_coherent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Ef) Hl')).
  - destruct (gc_body_module _ _ _ _ _ Hl) as [oD Hmd].
    unfold gc_loc in Hl'; rewrite (gc_module_child_not_frame _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hmd) in Hl'.
    destruct (gc_body_module _ _ _ _ _ Hl') as [oD' Hmd'].
    rewrite qname_in_app in Hmd'; exact (wf_gc_child _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ Hmd Hmd').
Qed.

The telescope of a stored body is one of assumptions.
Lemma gc_loc_tele_all_assumptions : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p T Φ, gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> all_assumptions T.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hl.
  assert (Hv : loc Θ Ξ p T Φ) by (unfold gc_loc in Hl; destruct (gc_frame Ξ p) eqn:E;
    [ injection Hl as ->; left; exact E | right; exact Hl ]).
  exact (syn_F_ass _ _ _ (proj1 (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) Hv))).
Qed.

What Resolution Hands Back is Well Typed

A resolved entry is typed: a definition's type is a closed term of the sort of its kind next to a large universe, and its body, if any, of that type; other entries ask nothing.
Definition entry_typed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_def _ _ r A B =>
      (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i) /\ (forall M, B = Some M -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ M : A)
  | ge_mod _ _ | ge_ind _ _ _ _ _ | ge_def_mod _ _ _ _ | ge_record _ _ _ _ => True
  end.

Definition resolved_globals_typed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop := globals_valid entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ Θ Ξ.

Theorem presup_exp_typ : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof.
  intros * H; exact (presup_exp_typ_v H (gctx_valid_syn _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx H)))).
Qed.

The type of a term is of a sort, or it is LevelSort and the term is a Level@n or a Π between types of levels.
Theorem presup_exp_typ_cases : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    typ_presup Θ Ξ Γ M A.
Proof.
  intros * H; exact (presup_exp_typ_cases_v H (gctx_valid_syn _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx H)))).
Qed.

The type of a term other than a former of a type of levels is of a sort.
Corollary presup_exp_typ_not_level : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> ~ level_type_former M ->
    exists S, type_sort S /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : S.
Proof.
  intros * H Hn; destruct (presup_exp_typ_cases H) as [? S HS HT | _ Hl]; [ eauto | contradiction ].
Qed.

Lemma entry_typed_def : forall Θ Ξ T r A M i b pv Θ2 Ξ2,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters T) ->
      
The telescope is of assumptions, so that the definition's filed body has no let at a type of levels (ctx_pi_type_kind)
      all_assumptions T ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ⊢ M : A -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    entry_typed Θ2 Ξ2 (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r T A) (Some (ctx_fn T M))).
Proof.
  intros * HA HL Ha HM HG He.
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (_ & Ht & _).
  assert (HT : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ++ ⋅) by (rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact (presup_exp_ctx HM)).
  rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r T) in HA, HM.
  destruct (ctx_pi_type_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HT (fun _ => Ha) HL HA) as [[j Hty] Hfn].
  split; [ exists j; exact (Ht _ _ _ Hty) | intros ? [= <-]; apply Ht, Hfn, HM ].
Qed.

Lemma entry_typed_ax : forall Θ Ξ r A i b pv Θ2 Ξ2,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    r <> ak_level ->
      
The frames' parameters are assumptions (wf_gstack_tele_all_assumptions)
      all_assumptions (gs_tele Ξ) ->
    globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ ->
    gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 ->
    entry_typed Θ2 Ξ2 (ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r (gs_tele Ξ) A) None).
Proof.
  intros * HA Hr Ha HG He.
  destruct (gctx_embedding_preserves_wf _ _ _ _ He) as (_ & Ht & _).
  assert (HT : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ++ ⋅) by (rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact (presup_exp_ctx HA)).
  rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r (gs_tele Ξ)) in HA.
  destruct (ctx_pi_type _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr HT HA) as [[j Hty] _].
  split; [ exists j; exact (Ht _ _ _ Hty) | discriminate ].
Qed.

Lemma entry_typed_ind : forall Θ Ξ D Θ2 Ξ2,
    decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ -> gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ2 Ξ2 -> decl_typed Θ2 Ξ2 D.
Proof. intros * HD _ He; eapply gctx_embedding_preserves_decl_typed; eassumption. Qed.

The Mutual Theorem


Theorem presup_global :
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> entry_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ mp E) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> module_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> globals_valid_along_embeddings entry_typed decl_typed Θ Ξ).
Proof.
  destruct (global_induction_all entry_typed decl_typed entry_typed_def entry_typed_ax entry_typed_ind)
    as (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4 & _ & H5 & H6 & H7 & _ & H8 & H9 & H10).
  exact (conj H1 (conj H2 (conj H3 (conj H4 (conj H5 (conj H6 (conj H7 (conj H8 (conj H9 H10))))))))).
Qed.

Corollary gctx_resolved_globals_typed : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> resolved_globals_typed Θ Ξ.
Proof. exact (global_induction entry_typed decl_typed entry_typed_def entry_typed_ax entry_typed_ind). Qed.
